translations.literal: Now I confer upon you the Chancellorship: the ten commanderies of Chenliu and southern Danyang and Xuancheng of Southern Yu Province; Wuxing, Dongyang, Xin'an, and Xinning of Yang Province; Yixing of Southern Xuzhou; and Poyang and Linchuan of Jiang Province—I enfeoff you as Duke of Chen.
translations.idiomatic: Now I confer the Chancellorship: Chenliu, southern Danyang, and Xuancheng of Southern Yuzhou; Wuxing, Dongyang, Xin'an, and Xinning of Yangzhou; Yixing of Southern Xuzhou; Poyang and Linchuan of Jiangzhou—ten commanderies—and enfeoff you as Duke of Chen.

sentences.zh: 錫茲青土，苴以白茅，爰定爾邦，用建塚社。

translations.literal: Bestow this azure earth, wrap it with white thatch, thereby fixing your state, thereby establishing your altar of soil and grain.
translations.idiomatic: Bestow this azure earth wrapped in white thatch, thereby fixing your state and establishing your altar of soil and grain.

sentences.zh: 昔旦、奭分陝，俱為保師，晉、鄭諸侯，咸作卿士。

translations.literal: Formerly the Duke of Zhou and Duke of Shao divided Shan; both were guardian teachers; Jin and Zheng among the feudal lords all served as ministers.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly the Duke of Zhou and Duke of Shao divided Shan; both were guardian teachers; lords of Jin and Zheng all served as ministers.

sentences.zh: 兼其內外，禮實攸宜。

translations.literal: Combining inner and outer, the rites were truly fitting.
translations.idiomatic: Combining inner and outer, the rites were truly fitting.

sentences.zh: 今命使持節、兼太尉王通授相國印綬，陳公璽紱；

translations.literal: Now I order Commissioner Bearing the Staff, Concurrent Grand Commandant Wang Tong to confer the Chancellor's seal and cord and the Duke of Chen's seal and ribbon;
translations.idiomatic: Now I order Commissioner Bearing the Staff and concurrent Grand Commandant Wang Tong to confer the chancellor's seal and cord and Duke of Chen's seal and ribbon;

sentences.zh: 使持節、兼司空王瑒授陳公茅土，金虎符第一至第五左，竹使符第一至第十左。

translations.literal: Commissioner Bearing the Staff, Concurrent Minister of Works Wang Chang to confer the Duke of Chen's earth and thatch, golden tiger tally first through fifth on the left, bamboo tally first through tenth on the left.
translations.idiomatic: Commissioner Bearing the Staff and concurrent Minister of Works Wang Chang to confer the duke's earth and thatch, golden tiger tallies one through five left, bamboo tallies one through ten left.

sentences.zh: 相國秩踰三鉉，任總百司，位絕朝班，禮由事革。

translations.literal: The Chancellor's rank exceeded the three handles; his task summed the hundred offices; his court rank surpassed the court cohort; rites followed the matter's change.
translations.idiomatic: The chancellor's rank exceeded the three handles; his task summed the hundred offices; his court rank surpassed the court cohort; rites followed the changed matter.

sentences.zh: 以相國總百揆，除錄尚書之號，上所假節、侍中貂蟬、中書監印章、中外都督太傅印綬、義興公印策，其鎮衛大將軍，揚州牧如故。

translations.literal: As Chancellor he summed the hundred affairs; the title Recording the Masters of Writing was removed; the seal and staff lent from above, attendant cicada-fish, Director of the Secretariat seal, seals of Grand Prefect and Grand Tutor inside and outside, and the Yi'ing Duke's seal and commission—as for Garrison Defender Grand General and Yangzhou Governor, they remained as before.
translations.idiomatic: As chancellor he summed all affairs; the title Recording the Masters of Writing was removed; lent seals of staff, attendant cicada, Secretariat director, inside-and-outside grand prefect and grand tutor, and Yi'ing duke's commission remained—as Garrison Defender Grand General and Yangzhou governor, unchanged.

sentences.zh: 又加公九錫，其敬聽後命：以公禮為楨幹，律等銜策，四維皆舉，八柄有章。

translations.literal: Also added to you the Nine Bestowments; reverently hear the later command: because your rites are the state's pillar, law equal to the bit-and-rein, the four dimensions all raised, the eight handles all ordered.
translations.idiomatic: Also added the Nine Bestowments; hear the later command: because your rites are the state's pillar and law equals bit-and-rein, the four dimensions rise and eight handles order.

sentences.zh: 是用錫公大輅、戎輅各一，玄牡二駟。

translations.literal: Therefore bestowed upon you one great carriage and one war carriage, black stallions two teams of four.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore bestowed one great carriage and one war carriage, teams of four black stallions each.

sentences.zh: 以公賤寶崇穀，疏爵待農，室富京坻，人知榮辱。

translations.literal: Because you despise treasure and honor grain, spread ranks to await farming, granaries rich as Jing mound, men knowing honor and shame.
translations.idiomatic: Because you despise treasure and honor grain, spread ranks to await farming, granaries rich as Jing mound, and men knowing honor and shame.

sentences.zh: 是用錫公袞冕之服，赤舄副焉。

translations.literal: Therefore bestowed upon you the robe and cap of the highest rank, with red shoes besides.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore bestowed the robe and cap of highest rank, with red shoes besides.

sentences.zh: 以公調理陰陽，燮諧風雅，三靈允降，萬國同和。

translations.literal: Because you harmonize yin and yang and harmonize wind and elegance, the three spirits truly descend and ten thousand states share harmony.
translations.idiomatic: Because you harmonize yin and yang and harmonize wind and elegance, the three spirits descend and ten thousand states share harmony.

sentences.zh: 是用錫公軒縣之樂，六佾之舞。

translations.literal: Therefore bestowed upon you suspended music and the six-row dance.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore bestowed suspended music and the six-row dance.

sentences.zh: 以公宣導王猷，弘闡風教，光景所照，鞮象必通。

translations.literal: Because you proclaim and guide the king's plan, broadly clarifying wind and teaching, wherever light and radiance reach, leather and ivory must connect.
translations.idiomatic: Because you proclaim the king's plan and broadly clarify wind and teaching, wherever light reaches, leather and ivory must connect.

sentences.zh: 是用錫公朱戶以居。

translations.literal: Therefore bestowed upon you vermilion doors to dwell in.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore bestowed vermilion doors to dwell in.

sentences.zh: 以公抑揚清濁，褒德進賢，髦士盈朝，幽人虛穀。

translations.literal: Because you raise the clear and lower the turbid, praise virtue and advance the worthy, fine scholars fill the court and recluses fill empty valleys.
translations.idiomatic: Because you raise the clear and lower the turbid, praise virtue and advance the worthy, fine scholars fill the court and recluses fill empty valleys.

sentences.zh: 是用錫公納陛以登。

translations.literal: Therefore bestowed upon you covered steps to ascend.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore bestowed covered steps to ascend.

sentences.zh: 以公嶷然廊廟，為世鎔範，折沖四表，臨御八荒。

translations.literal: Because you stand lofty in the hall and temple as the age's melting mold, breaking enemy thrust at the four quarters, facing and governing the eight wilds.
translations.idiomatic: Because you stand lofty in hall and temple as the age's mold, breaking enemy thrust at the four quarters and governing the eight wilds.

sentences.zh: 是用錫公虎賁之士三百人。

translations.literal: Therefore bestowed upon you three hundred tiger-guard warriors.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore bestowed three hundred tiger-guard warriors.

sentences.zh: 以公軌茲明罰，期在刑厝，象恭無赦，幹紀必誅。

translations.literal: Because you track bright punishment, aiming at punishments set aside, elephant-respect without pardon, violating law must be punished.
translations.idiomatic: Because you track bright punishment, aiming at punishments set aside, respectful law without pardon, violators must die.

sentences.zh: 是用錫公斧鉞各一。

translations.literal: Therefore bestowed upon you one axe and one yue.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore bestowed one axe and one yue.

sentences.zh: 以公英猷遠量，跨厲嵩、溟，包一車書，括囊寰宇。

translations.literal: Because your heroic plan and far measure stride Song and the dark sea, wrap one cart of documents, bag the whole cosmos.
translations.idiomatic: Because your heroic plan and far measure stride Song and the dark sea, wrap one cart of documents and bag the whole cosmos.

sentences.zh: 是用錫公彤弓一、彤矢百，盧弓十、盧矢千。

translations.literal: Therefore bestowed upon you one red bow and one hundred red arrows, ten black bows and one thousand black arrows.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore bestowed one red bow and one hundred red arrows, ten black bows and one thousand black arrows.

sentences.zh: 以公天經地義，貫徹幽明，春露秋霜，允供粢盛。

translations.literal: Because your heaven-pattern and earth-righteousness penetrate dark and bright, spring dew and autumn frost truly supply the sacrificial grain.
translations.idiomatic: Because your heaven-pattern and earth-righteousness penetrate dark and bright, spring dew and autumn frost truly supply sacrificial grain.

sentences.zh: 是用錫公秬鬯一卣，圭瓚副焉。

translations.literal: Therefore bestowed upon you one jar of black millet ale, with libation cup and ladle besides.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore bestowed one jar of black millet ale, with libation cup and ladle besides.

sentences.zh: 陳國置丞相以下，一遵舊式。

translations.literal: The Chen state established Chancellor and below, all following the old pattern.
translations.idiomatic: The Chen state established chancellor and below, all following the old pattern.

sentences.zh: 往欽哉！

translations.literal: Go—reverently!
translations.idiomatic: Go—reverently!

sentences.zh: 其恭循朕命，克相皇天，弘建邦家，允興鴻業，以光我高祖之休命。

translations.literal: Reverently follow my command, able to assist August Heaven, broadly establish the state and house, truly raise the great enterprise, to glorify my high ancestor's fine command.
translations.idiomatic: Reverently follow my command, assist August Heaven, broadly establish state and house, truly raise the great enterprise, and glorify my high ancestor's fine command.

sentences.zh: 十月戊辰，又進帝爵為王。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, on wuchen, the Emperor was again advanced in rank to King.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, wuchen, he was again advanced to King.

sentences.zh: 以揚州之會稽臨海永嘉建安、南徐州之晉陵信安、江州之尋陽豫章安成廬陵，並前為二十郡，益封陳國。

translations.literal: Kuaiji, Linhai, Yongjia, and Jian'an of Yang Province; Jinling and Xin'an of Southern Xuzhou; Xunyang, Yuzhang, Ancheng, and Luling of Jiang Province—with those before, twenty commanderies—increased the enfeoffment of the Chen state.
translations.idiomatic: Kuaiji, Linhai, Yongjia, and Jian'an of Yangzhou; Jinling and Xin'an of Southern Xuzhou; Xunyang, Yuzhang, Ancheng, and Luling of Jiangzhou—with the prior ten, twenty commanderies—increased Chen's enfeoffment.

sentences.zh: 其相國、揚州牧、鎮衛大將軍並如故。

translations.literal: Chancellor, Yangzhou Governor, and Garrison Defender Grand General all remained as before.
translations.idiomatic: Chancellor, Yangzhou governor, and Garrison Defender Grand General remained unchanged.

sentences.zh: 又命陳王冕十有二旒，建天子旌旗，出警入蹕，乘金根車，駕六馬，備五時副車，置旄頭雲罕，樂舞八佾，設鍾虡宮縣。

translations.literal: Also ordered the Chen King's cap with twelve tassels, establishing the Son of Heaven's banners, clearing the way when going out and on return, riding the golden-root carriage, driving six horses, equipped with five-season secondary carriages, setting Máo-head and cloud-banner, music and dance of eight rows, establishing bell-frames and palace suspended bells.
translations.idiomatic: Also ordered the Chen king's twelve-tassel cap, Son of Heaven banners, road clearing on exit and return, golden-root carriage drawn by six horses, five-season secondary carriages, Máo-head and cloud-banner, eight-row music and dance, bell-frames and palace bells.

sentences.zh: 王妃、王子、王女爵命之號，陳台百官，一依舊典。

translations.literal: The queen consort, princes, and princesses' titles and commands; Chen terrace's hundred offices—all followed the old canon.
translations.idiomatic: Queen consort, princes, and princesses' titles; Chen court's hundred offices—all followed the old canon.

sentences.zh: 辛未，梁帝禪位於陳，策曰：

translations.literal: On xinwei, the Liang Emperor abdicated to Chen; the commission read:
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei the Liang emperor abdicated to Chen; the commission read:

sentences.zh: 咨爾陳王，惟昔上古，厥初生人，驪連、栗陸之前，容成、大庭之世，杳冥慌忽，故靡得而詳焉。

translations.literal: Consult you, Chen King: in ancient upper antiquity, at the first birth of men, before Lilian and Lilu, in the eras of Rongcheng and Dating—dim and fleeting, hence nothing detailed can be known.
translations.idiomatic: Consult you, Chen King: in upper antiquity at mankind's first birth, before Lilian and Lilu, in the eras of Rongcheng and Dating—dim and fleeting, hence nothing detailed can be known.

sentences.zh: 自羲、農、軒、昊之君，陶唐、有虞之主，或垂衣而禦四海，或無為而子萬姓，居之如馭朽索，去之如脫弊屣，裁遇許由，便能舍帝，暫逢善卷，即以讓王。

translations.literal: From the lords Fu Xi, Shen Nong, Xuan Hao, the rulers Tao Tang and You Yu—some draped robes and governed the four seas, some non-active and were parent to the ten thousand surnames—dwelling was like driving rotten rope, departing was like doffing worn shoes; briefly meeting Xu You, then able to yield the throne; briefly encountering Shan Juan, then immediately yielding the kingship.
translations.idiomatic: From lords Fu Xi, Shen Nong, and Xuan Hao to rulers Tao Tang and You Yu—some draped robes and governed the four seas, some ruled through non-action—dwelling was like driving rotten rope, departing like doffing worn shoes; briefly meeting Xu You, then yielding the throne; briefly encountering Shan Juan, then yielding kingship.

sentences.zh: 故知玄扈琁璣，非關尊貴，金根玉輅，示表君臨。

translations.literal: Thus one knows the dark Huo and jade armillary sphere were not tied to nobility; golden-root carriage and jade chariot showed the mark of ruling.
translations.idiomatic: Thus the dark Huo and jade armillary were not tied to nobility; golden-root carriage and jade chariot marked the ruler.

sentences.zh: 及南觀河渚，東沈刻璧，菁華既竭，耄勤已倦，則抗首而笑，惟賢是與，澇然作歌，簡能斯授。

translations.literal: Reaching south viewing the river islet, east sinking the carved jade disk—youthful splendor already exhausted, aged diligence already weary—then raising head to laugh, only the worthy was given, pouring forth in song, selecting ability thus conferred.
translations.idiomatic: Reaching south to view the river islet and east to sink the carved jade disk—youthful splendor exhausted, aged diligence weary—then raising head to laugh, only the worthy was given, pouring forth in song, selecting ability thus conferred.

sentences.zh: 遺風餘烈，昭晰圖書，漢、魏因循，是為故實，宋、齊授受，又弘斯義。

translations.literal: Surviving wind and remaining blaze clearly in documents and books; Han and Wei followed in succession, hence the old reality; Song and Qi transmitted and received, again enlarged this righteousness.
translations.idiomatic: Surviving wind and remaining blaze stand clear in documents; Han and Wei followed in succession as old reality; Song and Qi transmitted and received, again enlarged this righteousness.

sentences.zh: 我高祖應期撫運，握樞禦宇，三後重光，祖宗齊聖。

translations.literal: Our high ancestor met the era and soothed the mandate, grasped the pivot and governed the realm; the three sovereigns again shone; ancestors and forefathers equally sage.
translations.idiomatic: Our high ancestor met the era and soothed the mandate, grasped the pivot and governed the realm; the three sovereigns shone again; ancestors equally sage.

sentences.zh: 及時屬陽九，封豕薦食，西都失馭，夷狄交侵。

translations.literal: When the time met yang's nine, the great boar came repeatedly to feed; the western capital lost control; barbarians and Di mutually invaded.
translations.idiomatic: When the time met yang's nine, the great boar came repeatedly to feed; the western capital lost control and barbarians and Di invaded together.

sentences.zh: 乃暨天成，輕弄龜鼎，惵惵黔首，若崩厥角，徽徽皇極，將甚綴旒。

translations.literal: Then reaching Heaven's completion, lightly playing with the turtle tripod; trembling black-haired heads, as if collapsing horn-tips; subtle subtle imperial pinnacle, about to exceed surplus tassel.
translations.idiomatic: Then reaching Heaven's completion, lightly playing with the turtle tripod; trembling people as if collapsing horn-tips; the subtle imperial pinnacle about to exceed a surplus tassel.

sentences.zh: 惟王乃聖乃神，欽明文思，二儀並運，四時合序，天錫智勇，人挺雄傑，珠庭日角，龍行虎步。

translations.literal: Only you are sage and divine, reverently bright in literary thought; two instruments jointly operate, four seasons combined in order; Heaven bestowed wisdom and courage, men raised heroic outstanding; pearl court and sun corner, dragon walk and tiger step.
translations.idiomatic: Only you are sage and divine, reverently bright in literary thought; two instruments jointly operate, four seasons in order; Heaven bestowed wisdom and courage, men raised heroic excellence; pearl court and sun corner, dragon walk and tiger step.

sentences.zh: 爰初投袂，曰乃勤王，電掃番禺，雲撤彭蠡，翦其元惡，定我京畿。

translations.literal: At first shaking sleeves, saying then to aid the king; lightning swept Panyu, clouds cleared Poyang; cut their chief villain, settled our capital region.
translations.idiomatic: At first shaking sleeves to aid the king; lightning swept Panyu, clouds cleared Poyang; cut the chief villain and settled our capital region.

sentences.zh: 及王賀帝弘，貿茲冠履，既行伊、霍，用保沖人。

translations.literal: When you congratulated the emperor and enlarged this crown and shoes, already acting Yi and Huo, thereby protecting the young person.
translations.idiomatic: When you congratulated the emperor and enlarged crown and shoes, already acting Yi and Huo, thereby protecting the young ruler.

sentences.zh: 震澤、稽陰，並懷叛逆，獯、羯醜虜，三亂皇都，裁命偏師，二邦自殄，薄伐獫狁，六戎盡殪。

translations.literal: Zhen Marsh and Kuaiji Yin both harbored rebellion; Xian and Jie ugly captives thrice disturbed the imperial capital; barely ordering partial armies, the two regions themselves perished; lightly campaigning against the Xianyun, the six Rong all exterminated.
translations.idiomatic: Zhen Marsh and Kuaiji Yin both rebelled; Xian and Jie captives thrice disturbed the capital; barely ordering partial armies, the two regions perished; lightly campaigning Xianyun, the six Rong were exterminated.

sentences.zh: 嶺南叛換，湘、郢連結，賊帥既禽，凶渠傳首。

translations.literal: Lingnan rebelled and changed; Xiang and Ying linked together; the bandit commander already captured, the vicious ringleader's head transmitted.
translations.idiomatic: Lingnan rebelled; Xiang and Ying linked; the bandit commander was taken and the vicious ringleader's head sent.

sentences.zh: 用能百揆時序，四門允穆，無思不服，無遠不屆，上達穹昊，下漏深泉，蛟魚並見，謳歌攸屬。

translations.literal: Able to make the hundred officials timely ordered, the four gates truly harmonious; none thought not to submit, none distant not to reach; above reaching the azure heaven, below leaking the deep spring; dragons and fish both appeared; songs of praise were thereby attached.
translations.idiomatic: You made the hundred officials timely ordered and four gates truly harmonious; none refused submission, none too distant to reach; above reaching azure heaven, below leaking deep springs; dragons and fish both appeared and songs of praise attached.

sentences.zh: 況乎長彗橫天，已征布新之兆，璧日斯既，實表更姓之符。

translations.literal: How much more the long comet crossing heaven already signaled the omen of spreading the new; the jade sun already set truly showed the token of changing surname.
translations.idiomatic: How much more the long comet crossing heaven already signaled spreading the new; the jade sun's setting truly showed changing surname.

sentences.zh: 七百無常期，皇王非一族。

translations.literal: Seven hundred without fixed term; emperor and king not one clan.
translations.idiomatic: Seven hundred years without fixed term; emperor and king not one clan.

sentences.zh: 昔木德既季，而傳祚于我有梁。

translations.literal: Formerly the Wood Virtue already in decline, transmission passed to our Liang.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly Wood Virtue already in decline, transmission passed to our Liang.

sentences.zh: 天之歷數，允集明哲。

translations.literal: Heaven's calendar and number truly gathered on the bright and wise.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven's calendar and number truly gathered on the bright and wise.

sentences.zh: 式遵前典，廣詢群議，王公卿尹，莫不攸屬，敬從人只之願，授帝位於爾躬。

translations.literal: Following the former canon, broadly consulting group opinion—princes, dukes, ministers, and governors—none not thereby attached; reverently following the people's and spirits' wish, confer the imperial throne upon your person.
translations.idiomatic: Following the former canon and broadly consulting opinion—princes, dukes, ministers, governors—none dissented; reverently following people and spirits, I confer the imperial throne upon you.

sentences.zh: 四海困窮，天祿永終，王其允執厥中，軌儀前式，以副溥天之望。

translations.literal: The four seas in distress, Heaven's blessing forever ended—you shall truly hold the center, follow the former pattern, to answer the vast heaven's hope.
translations.idiomatic: The four seas in distress, Heaven's blessing ended—you shall hold the center, follow the former pattern, and answer vast heaven's hope.

sentences.zh: 禋郊祀帝，時膺大禮，永固洪業，豈不盛與！

translations.literal: Sacrificing at the suburban altar to worship the Emperor, timely receiving the great rites, forever securing the great enterprise—how is it not grand!
translations.idiomatic: Sacrifice at the suburban altar to worship the Emperor, timely receive the great rites, forever secure the great enterprise—how is it not grand!

sentences.zh: 又命璽書，遣兼太保、尚書左僕射王通，兼太尉、司徒左長史王瑒，奉皇帝璽紱，受終之禮，一依唐、虞故事。

translations.literal: Also ordered the imperial commission, dispatching Concurrent Grand Preceptor, Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Wang Tong, and Concurrent Grand Commandant, Left Chief Clerk of the Minister of Works Wang Chang, to present the Emperor's seal and ribbon; the rites of receiving the end—all followed Tang and Yu's old story.
translations.idiomatic: Also ordered the imperial commission, dispatching concurrent Grand Preceptor and Left Vice Director Wang Tong and concurrent Grand Commandant and Minister of Works Left Chief Clerk Wang Chang to present the emperor's seal and ribbon; receiving-the-end rites all followed Tang and Yu's old story.

sentences.zh: 是日，梁帝遜于別宮。

translations.literal: That day, the Liang Emperor yielded to the separate palace.
translations.idiomatic: That day the Liang emperor withdrew to the separate palace.

sentences.zh: 帝謙讓再三，群臣固請，乃許之。

translations.literal: The Emperor declined repeatedly; the group of ministers firmly requested; then he permitted it.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor declined repeatedly; ministers firmly pressed; then he consented.

sentences.zh: 永定元年冬十月乙亥，皇帝即位于南郊，柴燎告天曰：

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the first year of Yongding, on yihai, the Emperor ascended the throne at the southern suburb; burning firewood he announced to Heaven:
translations.idiomatic: In Yongding 1, tenth month, yihai, the Emperor ascended the throne at the southern suburb; burning firewood he announced to Heaven:

sentences.zh: 皇帝臣霸先，敢用玄牡昭告於皇皇后帝：

translations.literal: The Emperor, your subject Baxian, dare use the black stallion to announce clearly to August August Heaven and August Earth:
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor, your subject Baxian, dares use the black stallion to announce clearly to August Heaven and August Earth:

sentences.zh: 梁氏以圮剝薦臻，曆運有極，欽若天應，以命於霸先。

translations.literal: The Liang house because collapse and stripping came repeatedly, its calendar and mandate had limit; reverently as Heaven responded, thereby commanding Baxian.
translations.idiomatic: The Liang house because collapse and stripping came repeatedly reached the limit of calendar and mandate; reverently as Heaven responded, it commanded Baxian.

sentences.zh: 夫肇有黎烝，乃樹司牧，選賢與能，未常厥姓。

translations.literal: At the beginning there were the black-haired masses; then tree overseers were established; selecting the worthy and able was not constant in surname.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning there were the people; then overseers were established; selecting the worthy and able was not constant in surname.

sentences.zh: 有梁末運，仍葉遘屯，獯醜憑陵，久移神器。

translations.literal: The Liang house's final fortune still inherited encountered difficulty; Xian ugliness relied on the frontier, long shifting the divine vessel.
translations.idiomatic: The Liang house's final fortune still inherited difficulty; Xian ugliness relied on the frontier and long shifted the divine vessel.

sentences.zh: 承聖在外，非能祀夏，天未悔禍，復罹寇逆。

translations.literal: Chengsheng was outside, not able to sacrifice to Xia; Heaven had not repented the calamity, again suffering invader bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Chengsheng was outside, unable to sacrifice to Xia; Heaven had not repented the calamity and again suffered invader bandits.

sentences.zh: 嫡嗣廢黜，宗枝僭詐，天地板蕩，紀綱泯絕。

translations.literal: The legitimate heir was deposed and removed; clan branches usurped and deceived; Heaven and Earth overturned; law and net were extinguished.
translations.idiomatic: The legitimate heir was deposed; clan branches usurped and deceived; Heaven and Earth overturned and law and net were extinguished.

sentences.zh: 霸先爰初投袂，大拯橫流，重舉義兵，實戡多難。

translations.literal: Baxian at first shook sleeves, greatly rescued the drowning torrent, again raised the righteous army, truly conquered many difficulties.
translations.idiomatic: Baxian at first shook sleeves, greatly rescued the drowning torrent, again raised the righteous army and truly conquered many difficulties.

sentences.zh: 廢王立帝，實有厥功，安國定社，用盡其力，是謂小康，方期大道。

translations.literal: Deposing the king and establishing the emperor truly had his merit; settling the state and fixing the altars exhausted his strength—this is called modest prosperity, just expecting the great Way.
translations.idiomatic: Deposing the king and establishing the emperor truly had merit; settling state and altars exhausted his strength—this is modest prosperity, just expecting the great Way.

sentences.zh: 既而煙雲表色，日月呈祥，除舊佈新，既彰玄象，遷虞事夏，且協謳歌，九域八荒，同布衷款，百神群祀，皆有誠願，梁帝高謝萬邦，授以大寶。

translations.literal: Then clouds and vapor showed color, sun and moon displayed auspice; removing the old and spreading the new already showed the dark image; shifting Yu and serving Xia moreover harmonized songs of praise; the nine domains and eight wilds together spread sincere petitions; the hundred spirits and group sacrifices all had sincere wish; the Liang Emperor highly yielded to ten thousand states and conferred the great treasure.
translations.idiomatic: Then clouds showed color and sun and moon displayed auspice; removing old and spreading new already showed the dark image; shifting Yu and serving Xia harmonized songs of praise; nine domains and eight wilds spread sincere petitions; hundred spirits and group sacrifices all wished sincerely; the Liang emperor highly yielded to ten thousand states and conferred the great treasure.

sentences.zh: 霸先自惟菲薄，讓德不嗣，至於再三，辭弗獲許。

translations.literal: Baxian himself considered humble and thin, yielding virtue not to succeed; reaching repeated times, declining he did not obtain permission.
translations.idiomatic: Baxian himself considered humble and thin, yielding virtue not to succeed; declining repeatedly he could not obtain permission.

sentences.zh: 僉以百姓須主，萬機難曠，皇靈眷命，非可謙拒。

translations.literal: All considered the hundred surnames needed a lord; myriad affairs hard to leave vacant; the imperial spirit favored the command—not possible to decline through modesty.
translations.idiomatic: All considered the people needed a lord and myriad affairs could not stand vacant; the imperial spirit favored the command—not possible to decline through modesty.

sentences.zh: 畏天之威，用膺嘉祚，永言夙志，能無慚德。

translations.literal: Revering Heaven's awesomeness, thereby receiving the fine fortune; forever speaking the early will—how could there be no shame in virtue?
translations.idiomatic: Revering Heaven's awesomeness, thereby receiving fine fortune; forever speaking the early will—how could there be no shame in virtue?

sentences.zh: 敬簡元辰，升壇受禪，告類上帝，用答甿心，永保于我有陳，惟明靈尚饗。

translations.literal: Reverently selecting the primary day, ascending the altar receiving abdication, announcing the category to August Heaven, thereby answering the mulberry folk's heart; forever securing our Chen—may the bright spirits still enjoy.
translations.idiomatic: Reverently selecting the primary day, ascending the altar to receive abdication, announcing to August Heaven, thereby answering the people's heart; forever securing our Chen—may the bright spirits still enjoy.

sentences.zh: 先是氛霧雨雪，晝夜晦冥，至是日，景氣清晏。

translations.literal: Earlier mist, fog, rain, and snow; day and night dark and dim; reaching this day, weather was clear and calm.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier mist, fog, rain, and snow darkened day and night; on this day weather cleared and calmed.

sentences.zh: 禮畢，輿駕還宮，臨太極前殿，大赦，改元。

translations.literal: When the rites were completed, the carriage returned to the palace, facing the Hall of Supreme Ultimate, great amnesty, changed the era name.
translations.idiomatic: When rites completed, the carriage returned to the palace, faced the Hall of Supreme Ultimate, proclaimed great amnesty, and changed the era name.

sentences.zh: 賜百姓爵二級，文武二等。

translations.literal: Bestowed upon the hundred surnames noble rank of two degrees, civil and military of two degrees.
translations.idiomatic: He bestowed noble rank of two degrees on the people and two degrees on civil and military officials.

sentences.zh: 鰥寡孤獨不能自存者，人穀五斛。

translations.literal: Widowers, widows, orphans, and solitaries unable to support themselves—five hu of grain per person.
translations.idiomatic: Widowers, widows, orphans, and solitaries unable to support themselves received five hu of grain each.

sentences.zh: 逋租宿責，皆勿復收。

translations.literal: Overdue rent and old debts—all not again collected.
translations.idiomatic: Overdue rent and old debts were not collected again.

sentences.zh: 有犯鄉論清議、贓汙淫盜者，皆洗除先注，與之更始。

translations.literal: Those who violated village discourse on pure conduct, corruption, lewdness, and theft—all washed clean of prior notation and given a fresh start.
translations.idiomatic: Those who had violated village standards of conduct or been marked for corruption, lewdness, or theft were cleared of prior notation and given a fresh start.

sentences.zh: 其長徒敕系，特皆原之。

translations.literal: Those in long-term hard labor and imprisonment—all specially pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: Those in long-term hard labor and imprisonment were specially pardoned.

sentences.zh: 亡官失爵，禁錮奪勞，一依舊典。

translations.literal: Lost office and forfeited rank, imprisonment and confiscated labor—all followed the old canon.
translations.idiomatic: Lost office and forfeited rank, imprisonment and confiscated labor—all followed the old canon.

sentences.zh: 又詔以江陰郡奉梁主為江陰王，行梁正朔，車旗服色，一依前准。

translations.literal: Also an edict made Jiangyin commandery support the Liang lord as King of Jiangyin, using Liang's calendar and reign, chariot flags and dress colors—all following the prior standard.
translations.idiomatic: Also an edict made Jiangyin commandery support the Liang lord as King of Jiangyin under Liang calendar and reign, chariot flags and dress colors all following prior standard.

sentences.zh: 梁皇太后為江陰國太妃，皇后為江陰國妃。

translations.literal: The Liang Empress Dowager as Grand Consort of Jiangyin State; the Empress as Consort of Jiangyin State.
translations.idiomatic: The Liang empress dowager became Grand Consort of Jiangyin State; the empress became Consort of Jiangyin State.

sentences.zh: 又詔百司各依位攝職。

translations.literal: Also an edict that the hundred offices each according to rank should hold acting posts.
translations.idiomatic: Also an edict that the hundred offices should each hold acting posts according to rank.

sentences.zh: 丙子，幸鍾山，祭蔣帝廟。

translations.literal: On bingzi, he visited Zhong Mountain and sacrificed at Emperor Jiang's temple.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi he visited Zhong Mountain and sacrificed at Emperor Jiang's temple.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，幸華林園覽辭訟，臨赦囚徒。

translations.literal: On wuyin, he visited Hualin Garden to review lawsuits, personally pardoning prisoners.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin he visited Hualin Garden to review lawsuits and personally pardoned prisoners.

sentences.zh: 己卯，分遣大使宣勞四方。

translations.literal: On jimao, he separately dispatched grand ambassadors to proclaim comfort to the four quarters.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao he separately dispatched grand ambassadors to proclaim comfort to the four quarters.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，詔出佛牙于杜姥宅，集四部設無遮大會。

translations.literal: On gengchen, an edict brought out the Buddha tooth from Old Lady Du's residence; gathered the four assemblies for an unbounded great assembly.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen an edict brought out the Buddha tooth from Old Lady Du's residence and gathered the four assemblies for an unbounded great assembly.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，追尊皇考曰景皇帝，廟號太祖，皇妣董太夫人曰安皇后，前夫人錢氏為昭皇后，世子克為孝懷太子。

translations.literal: On xinsi, posthumously honored the late Emperor's father as Emperor Jing, temple title Taizu; the late Empress Dowager Lady Dong as Empress An; the former consort Lady Qian as Empress Zhao; the heir Ke as Filial and Cherished Crown Prince.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi he posthumously honored his father as Emperor Jing, temple title Taizu; Lady Dong as Empress An; former consort Lady Qian as Empress Zhao; heir Ke as Filial and Cherished Crown Prince.

sentences.zh: 立夫人章氏為皇后。

translations.literal: Established Lady Zhang as Empress.
translations.idiomatic: He established Lady Zhang as empress.

sentences.zh: 癸未，尊景帝陵曰瑞陵、昭皇后陵曰嘉陵，依梁初園陵故事。

translations.literal: On guiwei, honored Emperor Jing's tomb as Ruiling and Empress Zhao's tomb as Jialing, following Liang's early garden-tomb precedent.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei he honored Emperor Jing's tomb as Ruiling and Empress Zhao's tomb as Jialing, following Liang's early garden-tomb precedent.

sentences.zh: 立刪定郎，刊定律令。

translations.literal: Established the office of Editor and Reviser, editing and promulgating laws and commands.
translations.idiomatic: He established the office of Editor and Reviser to edit and promulgate laws and commands.

sentences.zh: 戊子，遷景皇帝神主祔於太廟。

translations.literal: On wuzi, moved Emperor Jing's spirit tablet to join the Grand Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi he moved Emperor Jing's spirit tablet to join the Grand Temple.

sentences.zh: 是月，西討都督周文育、侯安都於郢州敗績，沒于王琳。

translations.literal: That month, Western Campaign Commander-in-Chief Zhou Wenyu and Hou Andu suffered defeat at Ying Province and were lost to Wang Lin.
translations.idiomatic: That month Western Campaign commander Zhou Wenyu and Hou Andu were defeated at Yingzhou and lost to Wang Lin.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙申，封皇兄子長城縣侯蒨為臨川郡王，頊襲封始興郡王，皇弟子曇朗襲封南康郡王。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on bingshen, enfeoffed the Emperor's elder brother's son, Marquis of Changcheng Qian, as Prince of Linchuan; Xu inherited enfeoffment as Prince of Shixing; the Emperor's younger brother's son Tanlang inherited enfeoffment as Prince of Nankang.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, bingshen, he enfeoffed his elder brother's son Marquis Changcheng Qian as Prince of Linchuan; Xu inherited as Prince of Shixing; nephew Tanlang inherited as Prince of Nankang.

sentences.zh: 庚申，都下火。

translations.literal: On gengshen, fire in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen fire broke out in the capital.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚辰，皇后謁太廟。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on gengchen, the Empress visited the Grand Temple.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, gengchen, the empress visited the Grand Temple.

sentences.zh: 是歲，周閔帝元年，及九月，塚宰宇文護廢閔帝而奉明帝。

translations.literal: That year was the first year of Northern Zhou Emperor Min; also in the ninth month, Grand Preceptor Yuwen Hu deposed Emperor Min and installed Emperor Ming.
translations.idiomatic: That year was Northern Zhou Emperor Min's first year; also in the ninth month Grand Preceptor Yuwen Hu deposed Emperor Min and installed Emperor Ming.

sentences.zh: 又為明帝元年。

translations.literal: Also became Emperor Ming's first year.
translations.idiomatic: It also became Emperor Ming's first year.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月乙未，以車騎將軍、開府儀同三司侯瑱為司空。

translations.literal: In spring of the second year, first month, on yiwei, General of Chariots and Cavalry, Commissioner with Grand Prefect insignia Hou Tian was appointed Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year's spring, first month, yiwei, General of Chariots and Cavalry Hou Tian with grand prefect insignia was appointed Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，祀南郊；

translations.literal: On xinchou, sacrificed at the southern suburb;
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou he sacrificed at the southern suburb;

sentences.zh: 大赦。

translations.literal: great amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: and proclaimed a great amnesty.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，遣中書舍人韋鼎、策吳興楚王神為帝。

translations.literal: On jiayin, dispatched Palace Attendant Wei Ding to invest the Spirit of Chuwang of Wuxing as Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin he dispatched palace attendant Wei Ding to invest the Spirit of Chuwang of Wuxing as emperor.

sentences.zh: 戊午，祀明堂。

translations.literal: On wuwu, sacrificed at the Bright Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu he sacrificed at the Bright Hall.

sentences.zh: 二月壬申，南豫州刺史沈泰奔齊。

translations.literal: In the second month, on renshen, Inspector of Southern Yu Province Shen Tai fled to Qi.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, renshen, Southern Yuzhou inspector Shen Tai fled to Qi.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，詔司空侯瑱總督水陸眾軍以禦齊。

translations.literal: On xinmao, an edict ordered Minister of Works Hou Tian to command all land and water armies to resist Qi.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao an edict ordered Minister of Works Hou Tian to command all land and water armies against Qi.

sentences.zh: 五月乙未，都下地震。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on yiwei, earthquake in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, yiwei, the capital shook with earthquake.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，立梁邵陵攜王廟室，祭乙太牢。

translations.literal: On renyin, established the shrine hall of Liang Prince of Shaoling Xie, sacrificing with the highest victim.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin he established the shrine hall of Liang Prince Shaoling Xie, sacrificing with the highest victim.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，帝幸大莊嚴寺，捨身。

translations.literal: On xinyou, the Emperor visited the Great Zhuangyan Monastery and offered his body.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou the Emperor visited Great Zhuangyan Monastery and offered his body.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，群臣表請還宮。

translations.literal: On renxu, the group of ministers memorialized requesting return to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu ministers memorialized requesting his return to the palace.

sentences.zh: 六月己巳，詔司空侯填、領軍將軍徐度討王琳。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on jisi, an edict ordered Minister of Works Hou Tian and Camp Commander General Xu Du to punish Wang Lin.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, jisi, an edict ordered Minister of Works Hou Tian and Camp Commander Xu Du to punish Wang Lin.

sentences.zh: 初，侯景之平也，太極殿被焚，承聖中議欲營之，獨闕一柱。

translations.literal: At first when Hou Jing was pacified, the Hall of Supreme Ultimate was burned; in Chengsheng they deliberated rebuilding it, only lacking one pillar.
translations.idiomatic: When Hou Jing was first pacified the Hall of Supreme Ultimate burned; in Chengsheng they planned rebuilding but lacked one pillar.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，有樟木大十八圍，長四丈五尺，流泊陶家後渚，監軍鄒子度以聞。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, camphor wood eighteen arm-spans around, four zhang five chi long, drifted and moored at the rear ford of the Tao family; Supervisor of the Army Zou Zidu reported it.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn's seventh month camphor wood eighteen arm-spans around and four zhang five chi long drifted to the Tao family's rear ford; army supervisor Zou Zidu reported it.

sentences.zh: 詔中書令沈眾兼起部尚書，構太極殿。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Director of the Secretariat Shen Zhong, concurrently Minister of Construction, to build the Hall of Supreme Ultimate.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Director of the Secretariat Shen Zhong, concurrently Minister of Construction, to build the Hall of Supreme Ultimate.

sentences.zh: 八月，周文育、侯安都等於王琳所逃歸，自劾廷尉，即日引見，宥之，並復本官。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, Zhou Wenyu, Hou Andu, and others escaped and returned from Wang Lin's place; they impeached themselves to the Court of Justice; that same day they were received in audience and pardoned, all restored to original posts.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Zhou Wenyu, Hou Andu, and others escaped from Wang Lin, impeached themselves at the Court of Justice, were received that same day, pardoned, and restored to original posts.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，加江州刺史周迪平南將軍、開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: On dinghai, added Jiangzhou Inspector Zhou Di as General Who Pacifies the South and Commissioner with Grand Prefect insignia.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Jiangzhou inspector Zhou Di was added as General Who Pacifies the South with grand prefect insignia.

sentences.zh: 冬十月庚午，遣鎮南將軍周文育都督眾軍出豫章，討餘孝勱。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on gengwu, dispatched General Who Guards the South Zhou Wenyu as Commander-in-Chief of the armies, setting out from Yuzhang to punish Yu Xiaoxun.
translations.idiomatic: In winter's tenth month, gengwu, he dispatched General Who Guards the South Zhou Wenyu as commander-in-chief from Yuzhang against Yu Xiaoxun.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，幸莊嚴寺，發金光明經題。

translations.literal: On yihai, visited Zhuangyan Monastery and initiated the Golden Light Sutra lecture.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai he visited Zhuangyan Monastery and initiated the Golden Light Sutra lecture.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，加高州刺史黃法氍平南將軍、開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: On dingyou, added Gaozhou Inspector Huang Faju as General Who Pacifies the South and Commissioner with Grand Prefect insignia.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou Gaozhou inspector Huang Faju was added as General Who Pacifies the South with grand prefect insignia.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲子，幸大莊嚴寺，設無礙大會，舍乘輿法物，群臣備法駕奉迎，即日還宮。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on jiazi, visited the Great Zhuangyan Monastery, establishing an unhindered great assembly; relinquished the imperial carriage and ritual objects; the group of ministers with full ceremonial escort welcomed him; that same day he returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, jiazi, he visited Great Zhuangyan Monastery for an unhindered great assembly, relinquished the imperial carriage and ritual objects, and returned the same day as ministers welcomed him with full ceremonial escort.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，加北江州刺史熊曇朗平西將軍、開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: On bingxu, added Northern River Inspector Xiong Tanlang as General Who Pacifies the West and Commissioner with Grand Prefect insignia.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Northern River inspector Xiong Tanlang was added as General Who Pacifies the West with grand prefect insignia.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月丁酉，鎮南將軍、廣州刺史歐陽頠即本號開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: In spring of the third year, first month, on dingyou, General Who Guards the South, Inspector of Guangzhou Ouyang Yu received his original title plus Commissioner with Grand Prefect insignia.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year's spring, first month, dingyou, General Who Guards the South and Guangzhou inspector Ouyang Yu received his original title plus grand prefect insignia.

sentences.zh: 是夜大雪，及旦，太極殿前有龍跡見。

translations.literal: That night great snow; at dawn, dragon tracks appeared before the Hall of Supreme Ultimate.
translations.idiomatic: That night snow fell heavily; at dawn dragon tracks appeared before the Hall of Supreme Ultimate.

sentences.zh: 甲子，廣州言仙人見於羅浮山寺小石樓。

translations.literal: On jiazi, Guangzhou reported immortals seen at the small stone tower of Luofu Mountain temple.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi Guangzhou reported immortals seen at the small stone tower of Luofu Mountain temple.

sentences.zh: 二月辛酉，加平西將軍、桂州刺史淳于量鎮西大將軍、開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: In the second month, on xinyou, added General Who Pacifies the West, Inspector of Guizhou Chunyu Liang as Grand General Who Guards the West and Commissioner with Grand Prefect insignia.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, xinyou, General Who Pacifies the West and Guizhou inspector Chunyu Liang was added as Grand General Who Guards the West with grand prefect insignia.

sentences.zh: 夏閏四月甲午，詔依前代置西省學士，兼取伎術士。

translations.literal: In the intercalary fourth month of summer, on jiawu, an edict followed former ages in establishing Western Bureau Academicians, also taking technicians and artisans.
translations.idiomatic: In summer's intercalary fourth month, jiawu, an edict followed former ages in establishing Western Bureau academicians and also taking technicians and artisans.

sentences.zh: 是時久不雨。

translations.literal: At that time there had long been no rain.
translations.idiomatic: At that time drought had long persisted.

sentences.zh: 丙午，幸鍾山祭蔣帝廟。

translations.literal: On bingwu, visited Zhong Mountain and sacrificed at Emperor Jiang's temple.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu he visited Zhong Mountain and sacrificed at Emperor Jiang's temple.

sentences.zh: 是日降雨，迄於月晦。

translations.literal: That day rain fell, continuing until month's end.
translations.idiomatic: That day rain fell and continued until month's end.

sentences.zh: 五月丙辰朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on bingchen, first day, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, bingchen, first day, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 有司奏舊儀帝御前殿，服朱紗袍、通天冠。

translations.literal: The relevant offices memorialized the old rite: the Emperor at the front hall, wearing vermilion gauze robe and penetration-heaven cap.
translations.idiomatic: The relevant offices memorialized the old rite: the emperor at the front hall wearing vermilion gauze robe and penetration-heaven cap.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「此乃前代承用，意有未同，合朔仰助太陽，宜備袞冕之服，自今永可為准。

translations.literal: An edict said: "This is what former ages inherited and used; the intent is not the same; at new moon one should assist the sun—proper robe and cap should be prepared; from now forever this may be the standard.
translations.idiomatic: An edict said: "Former ages inherited this, but the intent differs; at new moon one assists the sun—proper robe and cap should be worn; from now this shall be the standard forever.

sentences.zh: 」丙子，扶南國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: " On bingzi, Funan sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: " On bingzi Funan sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，北江州刺史熊曇朗殺都督周文育，舉兵反。

translations.literal: On yiyou, Northern River Inspector Xiong Tanlang killed Commander-in-Chief Zhou Wenyu and raised troops in rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou Northern River inspector Xiong Tanlang killed commander Zhou Wenyu and rebelled.

sentences.zh: 王琳遣其將常眾愛、曹慶率兵援餘孝勱。

translations.literal: Wang Lin sent his generals Chang Zhong'ai and Cao Qing with troops to aid Yu Xiaoxun.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Lin sent generals Chang Zhong'ai and Cao Qing to aid Yu Xiaoxun.

sentences.zh: 六月戊子，儀同侯安都敗眾愛等於左裏，獲琳從弟襲、主帥羊暕等四十餘人，眾愛遁走。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on wuzi, Commissioner of State Hou Andu defeated Zhong'ai and others at Zuoli, capturing Lin's younger cousin Xi, commander Yang Yang, and more than forty others; Zhong'ai fled.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, wuzi, Commissioner Hou Andu defeated Zhong'ai at Zuoli, capturing Wang Lin's cousin Xi, commander Yang Yang, and more than forty others; Zhong'ai fled.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，廬山人斬之，傳首建鄴。

translations.literal: On gengyin, a Lushan man beheaded him and sent the head to Jiankang.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin a Lushan man beheaded him and sent the head to Jiankang.

sentences.zh: 甲午，眾軍凱歸。

translations.literal: On jiawu, the mass of armies returned in triumph.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu the armies returned in triumph.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，帝不豫，遣兼太宰、尚書右僕射王通以疾告太廟，兼太宰、中書令謝哲告太社、南北郊。

translations.literal: On dingyou, the Emperor was unwell; dispatched Concurrent Grand Preceptor, Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Wang Tong to announce the illness to the Grand Temple; Concurrent Grand Preceptor, Director of the Secretariat Xie Zhe to announce to the Grand Altar of Soil and Grain and the southern and northern suburban altars.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou the Emperor was unwell; he dispatched concurrent Grand Preceptor and Right Vice Director Wang Tong to announce the illness to the Grand Temple and concurrent Grand Preceptor and Secretariat Director Xie Zhe to the Grand Altar and southern and northern suburban altars.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，帝小瘳。

translations.literal: On xinchou, the Emperor slightly recovered.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou the Emperor slightly recovered.

sentences.zh: 故司空周文育之柩至自建昌。

translations.literal: The former Minister of Works Zhou Wenyu's coffin arrived from Jianchang.
translations.idiomatic: Former Minister of Works Zhou Wenyu's coffin arrived from Jianchang.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，帝素服哭於朝堂，哀甚。

translations.literal: On renyin, the Emperor in plain robes wept in the court hall, grief extreme.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin the Emperor in plain robes wept in the court hall with extreme grief.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，上臨訊獄訟。

translations.literal: On guimao, the Emperor personally reviewed prison lawsuits.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao the Emperor personally reviewed prison lawsuits.

sentences.zh: 是夜，熒惑在天尊，上疾甚。

translations.literal: That night, Mars was at Celestial Sovereign; the Emperor's illness was severe.
translations.idiomatic: That night Mars stood at Celestial Sovereign; the Emperor's illness turned severe.

sentences.zh: 丙午，帝崩於璿璣殿，時年五十七。

translations.literal: On bingwu, the Emperor died in Xuanji Palace, age fifty-seven.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu the Emperor died in Xuanji Palace at age fifty-seven.

sentences.zh: 遺詔追臨川王蒨入纘大業。

translations.literal: The final edict summoned Prince of Linchuan Qian to enter and continue the great enterprise.
translations.idiomatic: The final edict summoned Prince of Linchuan Qian to enter and continue the great enterprise.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，殯於太極殿西階。

translations.literal: On jiayin, encoffined at the western steps of the Hall of Supreme Ultimate.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin he was encoffined at the western steps of the Hall of Supreme Ultimate.

sentences.zh: 八月甲午，群臣上諡曰武皇帝，廟號高祖。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on jiawu, the group of ministers submitted posthumous title Martial Emperor, temple title Gaozu.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, jiawu, ministers submitted posthumous title Martial Emperor, temple title Gaozu.

sentences.zh: 丙申，葬萬安陵。

translations.literal: On bingshen, buried at Wan'an Tomb.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen he was buried at Wan'an Tomb.

sentences.zh: 帝雄武多英略，性甚仁愛。

translations.literal: The Emperor was fierce in martial prowess with many heroic stratagems, and by nature very benevolent and loving.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor was fierce in martial prowess with many heroic stratagems and by nature deeply benevolent and loving.

sentences.zh: 及居阿衡，恒崇寬簡。

translations.literal: When he occupied the role of chief aide, he always honored leniency and simplicity.
translations.idiomatic: When he occupied the role of chief aide he always honored leniency and simplicity.

sentences.zh: 雅尚儉素，常膳不過數品。

translations.literal: He elegantly valued thrift and plainness; regular meals never exceeded several dishes.
translations.idiomatic: He valued thrift and plainness; regular meals never exceeded several dishes.

sentences.zh: 私饗曲宴，皆瓦器蚌盤，肴核庶羞，裁令充足，不為虛費。

translations.literal: Private feasts and informal banquets all used earthenware and clam shells; meat and fruit dishes were only made sufficient, not wastefully extravagant.
translations.idiomatic: Private feasts used earthenware and clam shells; meat and fruit were only made sufficient, never wastefully extravagant.

sentences.zh: 初平侯景及立敬帝，子女玉帛皆班將士。

translations.literal: At first when Hou Jing was pacified and when establishing Emperor Jing, daughters, sons, jade, and silk were all distributed to officers and soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: When Hou Jing was first pacified and when establishing Emperor Jing, daughters, sons, jade, and silk were all distributed to officers and soldiers.

sentences.zh: 其充闈房者，衣不重采，飾無金翠，聲樂不列於前。

translations.literal: Those filling the inner quarters wore no repeated colors in dress, no gold or kingfisher in ornament; music and song were not arrayed before them.
translations.idiomatic: Those filling the inner quarters wore no repeated colors, no gold or kingfisher ornament; music was not arrayed before them.

sentences.zh: 踐阼之後，彌厲恭儉。

translations.literal: After ascending the throne, he was the more strict in respectful thrift.
translations.idiomatic: After ascending the throne he was the more strict in respectful thrift.

sentences.zh: 故能隆功茂德，光于江左云。

translations.literal: Therefore he could raise great merit and abundant virtue, shining over the lands east of the river.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore he could raise great merit and abundant virtue, shining over the lands east of the river.

sentences.zh: 世祖文皇帝諱蒨，字子華，始興昭烈王之長子也。

translations.literal: Emperor Shizu, the Literary Emperor, taboo name Qian, courtesy name Zihua, was the eldest son of Prince Zhaolie of Shixing.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Shizu, the Literary Emperor, personal name Qian, style Zihua, was the eldest son of Prince Zhaolie of Shixing.

sentences.zh: 少沈敏，有識量，美容儀，留意經史。

translations.literal: In youth he was deep and keen, with judgment and capacity, handsome in appearance, attentive to classics and history.
translations.idiomatic: In youth he was deep and keen with judgment and capacity, handsome in appearance, attentive to classics and history.

sentences.zh: 武帝甚愛之，常稱吾家英秀。

translations.literal: Emperor Wu greatly loved him and often called him the outstanding talent of our house.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Wu greatly loved him and often called him the outstanding talent of their house.

sentences.zh: 梁太清初，帝夢兩日鬥，一大一小，大者光滅墜地，色正黃，其大如鬥，帝三分取一懷之。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Liang Taiqing, the Emperor dreamed two suns fighting, one large and one small; the large one's light extinguished and fell to earth, color pure yellow, size like a dipper; the Emperor took one third and kept it in his bosom.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Liang Taiqing the Emperor dreamed two suns fighting, one large and one small; the large one's light fell to earth pure yellow and dipper-sized; he took one third and kept it in his bosom.

sentences.zh: 侯景之亂，避地臨安縣郭文舉舊宅。

translations.literal: In Hou Jing's rebellion, he avoided the turmoil at the old residence of Guo Wenju in Lin'an county.
translations.idiomatic: In Hou Jing's rebellion he avoided turmoil at Guo Wenju's old residence in Lin'an county.

sentences.zh: 及武帝舉兵南下，景遣吳興太守信都遵收帝及衡陽獻王出都。

translations.literal: When Emperor Wu raised troops southward, Jing dispatched Wuxing Administrator Xin Duzun to seize the Emperor and Prince Xian of Hengyang and take them from the capital.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Wu raised troops southward, Hou Jing dispatched Wuxing administrator Xin Duzun to seize the Emperor and Prince Xian of Hengyang from the capital.

sentences.zh: 帝乃密袖小刀，候見景欲圖之。

translations.literal: The Emperor then secretly hid a small knife in his sleeve, waiting to see Jing and intending to assassinate him.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor secretly hid a small knife in his sleeve, waiting to see Hou Jing and intending to assassinate him.

sentences.zh: 及至，以付郎中王翻幽守，故其事不遂。

translations.literal: When he arrived, he was handed to Gentleman Wang Fan for secret detention; hence the affair did not succeed.
translations.idiomatic: When he arrived he was handed to gentleman Wang Fan for secret detention; hence the affair did not succeed.

sentences.zh: 武帝圍石頭，景欲加害者數矣，會景敗，乃得出。

translations.literal: When Emperor Wu besieged Shitou, Jing several times intended to harm him; just then Jing was defeated and he was able to emerge.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Wu besieged Shitou, Hou Jing several times intended to harm him; just then Jing was defeated and he emerged.

sentences.zh: 起家吳興太守。

translations.literal: He first left office as Administrator of Wuxing.
translations.idiomatic: He first left office as administrator of Wuxing.

sentences.zh: 武帝之討王僧辯也，先召帝與謀。

translations.literal: When Emperor Wu punished Wang Sengbian, he first summoned the Emperor to consult.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Wu moved against Wang Sengbian he first summoned the Emperor to consult.

sentences.zh: 時僧辯婿杜龕據吳興，兵眾甚盛，武帝密令帝還長城，立柵備之。

translations.literal: At that time Sengbian's son-in-law Du Kan held Wuxing; troops were very strong; Emperor Wu secretly ordered the Emperor to return to Changcheng and establish palisades in preparation.
translations.idiomatic: Then Sengbian's son-in-law Du Kan held Wuxing with a very strong force; Emperor Wu secretly ordered the Emperor back to Changcheng to raise palisades in preparation.

sentences.zh: 龕遣將杜泰乘虛掩至，將士相視失色，帝言笑自若，部分益明，於是眾心乃定。

translations.literal: Kan sent General Du Tai to seize the opportunity and suddenly arrive; officers and soldiers looked at one another with changed color; the Emperor spoke and laughed as before, deploying with greater clarity; then the host's heart was settled.
translations.idiomatic: Du Kan sent general Du Tai to strike suddenly; officers looked at one another in alarm; the Emperor spoke and laughed as before and deployed with greater clarity until the host's heart settled.

sentences.zh: 及武帝遣周文育討龕，帝遣將軍劉澄、蔣元舉攻下龕。

translations.literal: When Emperor Wu dispatched Zhou Wenyu to punish Kan, the Emperor sent Generals Liu Cheng and Jiang Yuanju to attack and capture Kan.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Wu dispatched Zhou Wenyu against Du Kan, the Emperor sent generals Liu Cheng and Jiang Yuanju to attack and capture him.

sentences.zh: 拜會稽太守。

translations.literal: Appointed Administrator of Kuaiji.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed administrator of Kuaiji.

sentences.zh: 武帝受禪，立為臨川王。

translations.literal: When Emperor Wu received abdication, he was established as Prince of Linchuan.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Wu received abdication he was established as Prince of Linchuan.

sentences.zh: 夢梁武帝以寶刀授己。

translations.literal: He dreamed Liang Emperor Wu bestowed upon him a precious knife.
translations.idiomatic: He dreamed Emperor Wu of Liang bestowed a precious knife upon him.

sentences.zh: 周文育、侯安都之敗於沌口，武帝詔帝入總軍政。

translations.literal: When Zhou Wenyu and Hou Andu were defeated at Zhunkou, Emperor Wu ordered the Emperor to enter and overall command military and civil affairs.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhou Wenyu and Hou Andu were defeated at Zhunkou, Emperor Wu ordered the Emperor to enter and overall command military and civil affairs.

sentences.zh: 尋命率兵城南皖。

translations.literal: Soon ordered to lead troops south to Wan.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon ordered to lead troops south to Wan.

sentences.zh: 永定三年六月丙午，武帝崩，皇后稱遺詔征帝入纂皇統。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the third year of Yongding, on bingwu, Emperor Wu died; the Empress, citing the final edict, summoned the Emperor to enter and continue the imperial succession.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongding 3, sixth month, bingwu, Emperor Wu died; the empress, citing the final edict, summoned the Emperor to continue the imperial succession.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，至自南皖，入居中書省。

translations.literal: On jiayin, arrived from Southern Wan and entered to dwell in the Directorate of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin he arrived from Southern Wan and entered the Directorate of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 皇后令帝嗣膺寶籙，帝辭讓至於再三，公卿固請，其日即皇帝位於太極前殿，大赦，詔州郡悉停奔赴。

translations.literal: The Empress ordered the Emperor to succeed to the precious register; the Emperor declined repeatedly; the dukes and ministers firmly requested; that same day he ascended the imperial throne at the Hall of Supreme Ultimate, great amnesty, edict that commanderies and prefectures all halt urgent travel.
translations.idiomatic: The empress ordered him to succeed to the throne; he declined repeatedly; dukes and ministers firmly pressed; that same day he ascended at the Hall of Supreme Ultimate, proclaimed great amnesty, and ordered commanderies and prefectures to halt urgent travel.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丙辰，尊皇后為皇太后。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on bingchen, honored the Empress as Empress Dowager.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn's seventh month, bingchen, he honored the empress as empress dowager.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以司空侯瑱為太尉，以南豫州刺史侯安都為司空，以南徐州刺史徐度為侍中、中撫軍將軍、開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: On xinyou, appointed Minister of Works Hou Tian as Grand Commandant, Inspector of Southern Yu Province Hou Andu as Minister of Works, and Inspector of Southern Xuzhou Xu Du as Attendant, General Who Pacifies the Center, and Commissioner with Grand Prefect insignia.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou he appointed Minister of Works Hou Tian as Grand Commandant, Southern Yuzhou inspector Hou Andu as Minister of Works, and Southern Xuzhou inspector Xu Du as attendant, General Who Pacifies the Center, with grand prefect insignia.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，重雲殿災。

translations.literal: On yichou, the Chongyun Hall burned.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Chongyun Hall burned.

sentences.zh: 八月庚戌，立皇子伯茂為始興王，奉昭烈王后，徙封始興嗣王頊為安成王。

translations.literal: On gengxu, established Prince Bozong as Prince of Shixing, serving the late Zhaolie queen; transferred Prince of Shixing Xu to Prince of Ancheng.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu he established Prince Bozong as Prince of Shixing serving the late Zhaolie queen and transferred Prince Shixing Xu to Prince of Ancheng.

sentences.zh: 九月辛酉，立皇子伯宗為皇太子，王公以下賜帛各有差。

translations.literal: On xinyou, established Prince Bozong as Crown Prince; princes, dukes, and below were bestowed silk each according to rank.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou he established Prince Bozong as crown prince; princes, dukes, and below received silk according to rank.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，立妃沈氏為皇后。

translations.literal: On yihai, established Consort Shen as Empress.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai he established Consort Shen as empress.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲子，齊文宣帝殂。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on jiazi, Northern Qi Emperor Wenxuan died.
translations.idiomatic: In winter's tenth month, jiazi, Northern Qi Emperor Wenxuan died.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙卯，王琳寇大雷，詔太尉侯瑱、司空侯安都、儀同徐度禦之。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on yimao, Wang Lin raided Dalei; an edict ordered Grand Commandant Hou Tian, Minister of Works Hou Andu, and Commissioner of State Xu Du to resist him.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, yimao, Wang Lin raided Dalei; an edict ordered Grand Commandant Hou Tian, Minister of Works Hou Andu, and Commissioner Xu Du to resist him.

sentences.zh: 是歲，周明帝改天王稱皇帝，復建年號曰武成元年。

translations.literal: That year, Northern Zhou Emperor Ming changed Heavenly King title to Emperor and restored era names as Wucheng first year.
translations.idiomatic: That year Northern Zhou Emperor Ming changed the Heavenly King title to Emperor and restored era names as Wucheng 1.

sentences.zh: 天嘉元年春正月癸丑，大赦，改元。

translations.literal: In spring of the first year of Tianjia, first month, on guichou, great amnesty, changed the era name.
translations.idiomatic: In Tianjia 1, spring, first month, guichou, he proclaimed great amnesty and changed the era name.

sentences.zh: 詔賜鰥寡孤獨不能自存者，人粟五斛。

translations.literal: An edict bestowed upon widowers, widows, orphans, and solitaries unable to support themselves five hu of grain per person.
translations.idiomatic: An edict bestowed five hu of grain each on widowers, widows, orphans, and solitaries unable to support themselves.

sentences.zh: 孝悌力田，殊行異等，加爵一級。

translations.literal: Filial piety, fraternal duty, and diligent farming, special conduct and exceptional rank—added noble rank one degree.
translations.idiomatic: Filial piety, fraternal duty, diligent farming, and exceptional conduct earned one added degree of noble rank.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，分遣使者宣勞四方。

translations.literal: On jiayin, separately dispatched envoys to proclaim comfort to the four quarters.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin he separately dispatched envoys to proclaim comfort to the four quarters.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，祀南郊。

translations.literal: On xinyou, sacrificed at the southern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou he sacrificed at the southern suburb.

sentences.zh: 詔賜人爵一級。

translations.literal: An edict bestowed noble rank one degree upon the people.
translations.idiomatic: An edict bestowed one degree of noble rank on the people.

sentences.zh: 二月丙申，太尉侯瑱敗王琳於梁山，敗齊兵於博望，禽齊將劉伯球。

translations.literal: In the second month, on bingshen, Grand Commandant Hou Tian defeated Wang Lin at Liang Mountain and defeated Qi troops at Bowang, capturing Qi general Liu Boqiu.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, bingshen, Grand Commandant Hou Tian defeated Wang Lin at Liang Mountain and Qi at Bowang, capturing Qi general Liu Boqiu.

sentences.zh: 王琳及其主蕭莊奔齊。

translations.literal: Wang Lin and his lord Xiao Zhuang fled to Qi.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Lin and his lord Xiao Zhuang fled to Qi.

sentences.zh: 庚子，分遣使者齎璽書宣勞四方。

translations.literal: On gengzi, separately dispatched envoys bearing imperial commissions to proclaim comfort to the four quarters.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi he separately dispatched envoys bearing imperial commissions to proclaim comfort to the four quarters.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，遣太尉侯瑱鎮盆城。

translations.literal: On yisi, dispatched Grand Commandant Hou Tian to garrison Pencheng.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi he dispatched Grand Commandant Hou Tian to garrison Pencheng.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，立武帝第六子昌為衡陽王。

translations.literal: On gengxu, established Emperor Wu's sixth son Chang as Prince of Hengyang.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu he established Emperor Wu's sixth son Chang as Prince of Hengyang.

sentences.zh: 三月丙辰，蕭莊所署郢州刺史孫瑒舉州內附。

translations.literal: In the third month, on bingchen, Sun Yang, Ying Province Inspector appointed by Xiao Zhuang, surrendered the province and submitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, bingchen, Yingzhou inspector Sun Yang appointed by Xiao Zhuang surrendered the province.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，江州刺史周迪平南中，斬賊帥熊曇朗，傳首建鄴。

translations.literal: On dingsi, Jiangzhou Inspector Zhou Di pacified the southern center and beheaded the bandit commander Xiong Tanlang, sending the head to Jiankang.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Jiangzhou inspector Zhou Di pacified the southern center and beheaded bandit commander Xiong Tanlang, sending the head to Jiankang.

sentences.zh: 戊午，齊軍棄魯山城走，詔南豫州刺史程靈洗守之。

translations.literal: On wuwu, Qi troops abandoned Lushan city and fled; an edict ordered Southern Yuzhou Inspector Cheng Lingxi to hold it.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu Qi abandoned Lushan city and fled; an edict ordered Southern Yuzhou inspector Cheng Lingxi to hold it.

sentences.zh: 丙子，衡陽王昌沈于江。

translations.literal: On bingzi, Prince of Hengyang Chang was drowned in the river.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi Prince of Hengyang Chang was drowned in the river.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁亥，立皇子伯信為衡陽王，奉獻王后。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on dinghai, established Prince Bozong as Prince of Hengyang, serving the late Xian queen.
translations.idiomatic: In summer's fourth month, dinghai, he established Prince Bozong as Prince of Hengyang serving the late Xian queen.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，周明帝崩。

translations.literal: On xinchou, Northern Zhou Emperor Ming died.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Northern Zhou Emperor Ming died.

sentences.zh: 六月辛巳，改諡皇祖妣景安皇后曰景文皇后。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on xinsi, changed the posthumous title of the imperial grandfather's consort Empress Jing'an to Empress Jingwen.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, xinsi, he changed the posthumous title of the imperial grandfather's consort from Jing'an to Jingwen.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，詔改葬梁元帝于江寧舊塋，車旗禮章，悉用梁典，仍依魏葬漢獻帝故事。

translations.literal: On renchen, an edict reburied Emperor Yuan of Liang at the old tomb mound in Jiangning; chariot flags and ritual insignia all used Liang canon, still following Wei's burial of Emperor Xian of Han precedent.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen an edict reburied Emperor Yuan of Liang at the old mound in Jiangning with Liang chariot flags and ritual insignia, following Wei's burial of Emperor Xian of Han.

sentences.zh: 甲午，追策故始興昭烈王妃曰孝妃。

translations.literal: On jiawu, posthumously invested the late Princess Consort of Zhaolie of Shixing.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu he posthumously invested the late Princess Consort of Zhaolie of Shixing.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，國哀周忌，上臨於太極前殿，百僚陪哭。

translations.literal: On xinchou, national mourning on the Zhou anniversary; the Emperor personally attended at the Hall of Supreme Ultimate; the hundred officials accompanied in weeping.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, national mourning on the Zhou anniversary, the Emperor personally attended at the Hall of Supreme Ultimate and the hundred officials wept with him.

sentences.zh: 赦建鄴殊死以下。

translations.literal: Pardoned those below capital punishment in Jiankang.
translations.idiomatic: He pardoned those below capital punishment in Jiankang.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丙辰，立皇子伯山為鄱陽王。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on bingchen, established Prince Boshan as Prince of Poyang.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn's seventh month, bingchen, he established Prince Boshan as Prince of Poyang.

sentences.zh: 八月壬午，齊孝昭帝廢其主殷而自立。

translations.literal: On renwu, Northern Qi Emperor Xiaozhao deposed his lord Yin and installed himself.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu Northern Qi Emperor Xiaozhao deposed his lord Yin and installed himself.

sentences.zh: 戊子，詔非兵器及國容所須，金銀珠玉衣服雜玩，悉皆禁斷。

translations.literal: On wuzi, an edict prohibited all gold, silver, pearls, jade, clothing, and miscellaneous curios not needed for weapons or state regalia.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi an edict prohibited gold, silver, pearls, jade, clothing, and curios not needed for weapons or state regalia.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，幸正陽堂閱武。

translations.literal: On dingyou, visited the Hall of Correct Yang to review martial displays.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou he visited the Hall of Correct Yang to review martial displays.

sentences.zh: 九月癸丑，彗星見。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on guichou, a comet appeared.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, guichou, a comet appeared.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，周將獨孤盛領水軍趣巴、湘，與賀若敦水陸俱進，太尉侯瑱自尋陽禦之。

translations.literal: On yimao, Northern Zhou General Dugu Sheng led the navy toward Ba and Xiang, advancing together with He Ruo Dun by land and water; Grand Commandant Hou Tian from Xunyang resisted him.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Northern Zhou general Dugu Sheng led the navy toward Ba and Xiang with He Ruo Dun advancing together by land and water; Grand Commandant Hou Tian from Xunyang resisted.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸巳，侯瑱襲破獨孤盛于楊葉洲，盛登岸築城自保。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on guisi, Hou Tian raided and broke Dugu Sheng at Yangye Isle; Sheng went ashore and built a city to defend himself.
translations.idiomatic: In winter's tenth month, guisi, Hou Tian raided and broke Dugu Sheng at Yangye Isle; Sheng went ashore and walled himself in.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，詔司空侯安都率眾會侯瑱南拒周軍。

translations.literal: On dingyou, an edict ordered Minister of Works Hou Andu to lead troops to join Hou Tian in resisting Zhou armies southward.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou an edict ordered Minister of Works Hou Andu to join Hou Tian resisting Zhou armies southward.

sentences.zh: 十二月己亥，周巴陵城主尉遲憲降。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on jihai, Northern Zhou Balin city commander Yuchi Xian surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, jihai, Northern Zhou Balin commander Yuchi Xian surrendered.

sentences.zh: 庚子，獨孤盛潛遁走。

translations.literal: On gengzi, Dugu Sheng secretly fled.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Dugu Sheng secretly fled.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月庚戌，大赦。

translations.literal: In spring of the second year, first month, on gengxu, great amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year's spring, first month, gengxu, he proclaimed great amnesty.

sentences.zh: 辛未，周湘州城主殷亮降，湘州平。

translations.literal: On xinwei, Northern Zhou Xiang Province city commander Yin Liang surrendered; Xiang Province was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Northern Zhou Xiangzhou commander Yin Liang surrendered and Xiangzhou was pacified.

sentences.zh: 二月庚寅，曲赦湘州諸郡。

translations.literal: In the second month, on gengyin, partial amnesty for the commanderies of Xiang Province.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, gengyin, partial amnesty for Xiangzhou commanderies.

sentences.zh: 三月乙卯，太尉、湘州刺史侯瑱薨。

translations.literal: In the third month, on yimao, Grand Commandant and Xiang Province Inspector Hou Tian died.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, yimao, Grand Commandant and Xiangzhou inspector Hou Tian died.

sentences.zh: 夏六月己亥，齊人通好。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of summer, on jihai, Qi men came seeking good relations.
translations.idiomatic: In summer's sixth month, jihai, Qi envoys came seeking good relations.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丙午，周將賀若敦遁歸，武陵、天門、南平、義陽、河東、宜都郡悉平。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on bingwu, Northern Zhou General He Ruo Dun fled home; Wuling, Tianmen, Nanping, Yiyang, Hedong, and Yidu commanderies were all pacified.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn's seventh month, bingwu, Northern Zhou general He Ruo Dun fled home; Wuling, Tianmen, Nanping, Yiyang, Hedong, and Yidu were all pacified.

sentences.zh: 九月甲寅，詔以故太尉侯瑱、故司空周文育、故開府儀同三司杜僧明、故中護軍胡穎、故領軍陳擬配食武帝廟庭。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on jiayin, an edict made the late Grand Commandant Hou Tian, late Minister of Works Zhou Wenyu, late Commissioner with Grand Prefect insignia Du Sengming, late General Who Protects the Army Hu Ying, and late Camp Commander Chen Ni share sacrifice at Emperor Wu's temple hall.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, jiayin, an edict made the late Hou Tian, Zhou Wenyu, Du Sengming, Hu Ying, and Chen Ni share sacrifice at Emperor Wu's temple hall.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸丑，霍州西山蠻率部內屬。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on guichou, Western Mountain barbarians of Huo Province led their tribes to submit.
translations.idiomatic: In winter's tenth month, guichou, Western Mountain barbarians of Huozhou led their tribes to submit.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，高麗國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: On yimao, Goguryeo sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Goguryeo sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲辰，齊孝昭帝殂。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on jiachen, Northern Qi Emperor Xiaozhao died.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, jiachen, Northern Qi Emperor Xiaozhao died.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲申，立始興國廟於都下，用王者禮。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on jiashen, established the Shixing State temple in the capital, using kingly rites.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, jiashen, he established the Shixing State temple in the capital with kingly rites.

sentences.zh: 以國用不足，立煮海鹽賦及榷酤科。

translations.literal: Because state revenue was insufficient, established the boiled-sea salt tax and the monopoly wine tax.
translations.idiomatic: Because state revenue was insufficient he established the boiled-sea salt tax and monopoly wine tax.

sentences.zh: 先是縉州刺史留異應王琳，丙戌，詔司空侯安都討之。

translations.literal: Earlier Jian Province Inspector Liu Yi had responded to Wang Lin; on bingxu, an edict ordered Minister of Works Hou Andu to punish him.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Jianzhou inspector Liu Yi had joined Wang Lin; on bingxu an edict ordered Minister of Works Hou Andu to punish him.

sentences.zh: 是歲，周武帝保定元年。

translations.literal: That year was Northern Zhou Emperor Wu's Baoding first year.
translations.idiomatic: That year was Northern Zhou Emperor Wu's Baoding 1.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月庚戌，設帷宮於南郊，幣告胡公以配天。

translations.literal: In spring of the third year, first month, on gengxu, established the tent-palace at the southern suburb; with silk announced to Duke Hu as mate to Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year's spring, first month, gengxu, he established the tent-palace at the southern suburb and with silk announced to Duke Hu as mate to Heaven.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，祀南郊，詔賜人爵一級，孝悌力田加一等。

translations.literal: On xinhai, sacrificed at the southern suburb; an edict bestowed noble rank one degree upon the people; filial piety, fraternal duty, and diligent farming added one rank.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai he sacrificed at the southern suburb; an edict bestowed one degree of noble rank on the people and added one rank for filial piety, fraternal duty, and diligent farming.

sentences.zh: 二月，梁宣帝殂。

translations.literal: In the second month, Emperor Xuan of Liang died.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month Emperor Xuan of Liang died.

sentences.zh: 閏月己酉，以百濟王餘明為撫東大將軍，高麗王高湯為甯東將軍。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on jiyou, made Baekje King Yu Myeong General Who Pacifies the East and Goguryeo King Go Tang General Who Pacifies the East.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, jiyou, he made Baekje king Yu Myeong General Who Pacifies the East and Goguryeo king Go Tang General Who Pacifies the East.

sentences.zh: 江州刺史周迪舉兵應留異。

translations.literal: Jiangzhou Inspector Zhou Di raised troops in response to Liu Yi.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangzhou inspector Zhou Di raised troops in response to Liu Yi.

sentences.zh: 甲子，改鑄五銖錢。

translations.literal: On jiazi, recast five-zhu coins.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi he recast five-zhu coins.

sentences.zh: 三月丙子，安成王頊至自周。

translations.literal: In the third month, on bingzi, Prince of Ancheng Xu returned from Zhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, bingzi, Prince of Ancheng Xu returned from Zhou.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，以安右將軍吳明徹為安南將軍、江州刺史，督眾軍南討。

translations.literal: On dingchou, made General Who Pacifies the Right Wu Mingche General Who Pacifies the South and Inspector of Jiangzhou, commanding the armies in southern punishment.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou he made General Who Pacifies the Right Wu Mingche General Who Pacifies the South and Jiangzhou inspector, commanding southern punishment.

sentences.zh: 甲申，大赦。

translations.literal: On jiashen, great amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen he proclaimed great amnesty.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，司空侯安都破留異於桃枝嶺，異奔晉安，東陽郡平。

translations.literal: On gengyin, Minister of Works Hou Andu broke Liu Yi at Taozhi Ridge; Yi fled to Jin'an and Dongyang commandery was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Minister of Works Hou Andu broke Liu Yi at Taozhi Ridge; Yi fled to Jin'an and Dongyang commandery was pacified.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸卯，曲赦東陽郡。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on guimao, partial amnesty for Dongyang commandery.
translations.idiomatic: In summer's fourth month, guimao, partial amnesty for Dongyang commandery.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，齊人來聘。

translations.literal: On yisi, Qi men came seeking audience.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi Qi envoys came seeking audience.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己丑，皇太子納妃王氏，在位文武賜帛各有差，孝悌力田為父後者，賜爵二級。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on jichou, the Crown Prince took Consort Wang; civil and military officials in office were bestowed silk each according to rank; filial piety, fraternal duty, and diligent farming who were heirs to fathers received noble rank two degrees.
