translations.idiomatic: In autumn's seventh month, jichou, the crown prince took Consort Wang; officials received silk by rank and filial farmers who were heirs received two degrees of noble rank.

sentences.zh: 九月戊辰朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on wuchen, first day, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, wuchen, first day, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 以侍中到仲舉為尚書右僕射。

translations.literal: Made Attendant Dao Zhongju Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: He made attendant Dao Zhongju Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，周迪請降。

translations.literal: On dinghai, Zhou Di requested surrender.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Zhou Di requested surrender.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月丙子，幹陀利國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: In spring of the fourth year, first month, on bingzi, Gandhara sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year's spring, first month, bingzi, Gandhara sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 甲申，周迪走投閩州，刺史陳寶應納之。

translations.literal: On jiashen, Zhou Di fled seeking refuge in Min Province; Inspector Chen Baoying received him.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen Zhou Di fled to Min Province and inspector Chen Baoying received him.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛丑，設無礙大會，捨身於太極前殿。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on xinchou, established an unhindered great assembly; offered his body at the Hall of Supreme Ultimate.
translations.idiomatic: In summer's fourth month, xinchou, he established an unhindered great assembly and offered his body at the Hall of Supreme Ultimate.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，加驃騎將軍、揚州刺史安成王頊開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: On yimao, added General of Fast Cavalry, Yangzhou Inspector Prince of Ancheng Xu as Commissioner with Grand Prefect insignia.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao General of Fast Cavalry and Yangzhou inspector Prince of Ancheng Xu received grand prefect insignia.

sentences.zh: 六月癸巳，司空侯安都賜死。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on guisi, Minister of Works Hou Andu was granted death.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, guisi, Minister of Works Hou Andu was granted death.

sentences.zh: 秋九月壬戌，開府儀同三司、廣州刺史歐陽頠薨。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of autumn, on renxu, Commissioner with Grand Prefect insignia, Inspector of Guangzhou Ouyang Yu died.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn's ninth month, renxu, Commissioner Ouyang Yu, Guangzhou inspector, died.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，曲赦都下。

translations.literal: On guihai, partial amnesty for the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai partial amnesty for the capital.

sentences.zh: 辛未，周迪復寇臨川，詔護軍將軍章昭達討平之。

translations.literal: On xinwei, Zhou Di again raided Linchuan; an edict ordered General Who Protects the Army Zhang Zhaoda to punish and pacify him.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Zhou Di again raided Linchuan; an edict ordered General Who Protects the Army Zhang Zhaoda to crush him.

sentences.zh: 冬十二月丙申，大赦。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of winter, on bingshen, great amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: In winter's twelfth month, bingshen, he proclaimed great amnesty.

sentences.zh: 詔昭達進軍建安，討陳寶應。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Zhang Zhaoda to advance the army to Jian'an and punish Chen Baoying.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Zhang Zhaoda to advance to Jian'an against Chen Baoying.

sentences.zh: 五年春三月壬午，詔以故護軍將軍周鐵武配食武帝廟庭。

translations.literal: In spring of the fifth year, third month, on renwu, an edict made the late General Who Protects the Army Zhou Tiewu share sacrifice at Emperor Wu's temple hall.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year's spring, third month, renwu, an edict made the late Zhou Tiewu share sacrifice at Emperor Wu's temple hall.

sentences.zh: 夏五月，周、齊並遣使來聘。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of summer, Zhou and Qi both dispatched envoys seeking audience.
translations.idiomatic: In summer's fifth month Zhou and Qi both dispatched envoys seeking audience.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁丑，曲赦都下。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on dingchou, partial amnesty for the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn's seventh month, dingchou, partial amnesty for the capital.

sentences.zh: 九月，城西城。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, the western city wall.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month the western city wall was built.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月己丑，章昭達禽陳寶應、留異，送建鄴，晉安郡平。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of winter, on jichou, Zhang Zhaoda captured Chen Baoying and Liu Yi and sent them to Jiankang; Jin'an commandery was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: In winter's eleventh month, jichou, Zhang Zhaoda captured Chen Baoying and Liu Yi and sent them to Jiankang; Jin'an commandery was pacified.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，以護軍將軍章昭達為鎮軍將軍、開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: On jiachen, made General Who Protects the Army Zhang Zhaoda General Who Guards the Army and Commissioner with Grand Prefect insignia.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen he made General Who Protects the Army Zhang Zhaoda General Who Guards the Army with grand prefect insignia.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲子，曲赦建安、晉安二郡。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on jiazi, partial amnesty for Jian'an and Jin'an commanderies.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, jiazi, partial amnesty for Jian'an and Jin'an commanderies.

sentences.zh: 討陳寶應將士死王事者，並給棺槥，送還本鄉，並復其家。

translations.literal: Officers and soldiers who died in royal service punishing Chen Baoying—all given coffins and sent back to their native districts, their families also restored.
translations.idiomatic: Officers and soldiers who died punishing Chen Baoying received coffins and return to their native districts, their families restored.

sentences.zh: 癸未，齊人來聘。

translations.literal: On guiwei, Qi men came seeking audience.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei Qi envoys came seeking audience.

sentences.zh: 六年春正月甲午，皇太子加元服，王公以下，賜帛各有差，孝悌力田為父後者，賜爵一級，鰥寡孤獨不能自存者，穀人五斛。

translations.literal: In spring of the sixth year, first month, on jiawu, the Crown Prince received capping; princes, dukes, and below were bestowed silk each according to rank; filial piety, fraternal duty, and diligent farming who were heirs to fathers received noble rank one degree; widowers, widows, orphans, and solitaries unable to support themselves received five hu of grain per person.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year's spring, first month, jiawu, the crown prince received capping; princes and below received silk by rank; filial heirs received one degree of noble rank; the destitute received five hu of grain each.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲寅，以開府儀同三司、揚州刺史安成王頊為司空。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on jiayin, made Commissioner with Grand Prefect insignia, Yangzhou Inspector Prince of Ancheng Xu Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: In summer's fourth month, jiayin, Commissioner and Yangzhou inspector Prince of Ancheng Xu became Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 五月，齊武成帝傳位於太子緯，自號太上皇帝。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, Northern Qi Emperor Wucheng transmitted the throne to Crown Prince Wei and styled himself Retired Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month Northern Qi Emperor Wucheng transmitted the throne to Crown Prince Wei and styled himself Retired Emperor.

sentences.zh: 六月辛酉，彗星見於上臺北。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on xinyou, a comet appeared north of Upper Terrace.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, xinyou, a comet appeared north of Upper Terrace.

sentences.zh: 周人來聘。

translations.literal: Zhou men came seeking audience.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou envoys came seeking audience.

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸未，有大風自西南至，廣百餘步，激壞靈台候樓。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on guiwei, a great wind came from the southwest, more than one hundred paces wide, striking and destroying the Spirit Platform observation tower.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn's seventh month, guiwei, a great wind from the southwest more than one hundred paces wide struck and destroyed the Spirit Platform observation tower.

sentences.zh: 甲申，儀賢堂無故自壞。

translations.literal: On jiashen, the Hall of Esteeming Worthies collapsed without cause.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen the Hall of Esteeming Worthies collapsed without cause.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，臨川太守駱牙斬周迪，傳首建鄴，梟於朱雀航。

translations.literal: On bingxu, Linchuan Administrator Luo Ya beheaded Zhou Di, sent the head to Jiankang, and displayed it at the Zhuque Bridge.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Linchuan administrator Luo Ya beheaded Zhou Di, sent the head to Jiankang, and displayed it at Zhuque Bridge.

sentences.zh: 八月己卯，立皇子伯固為新安王，伯恭為晉安王，伯仁為廬陵王，伯義為江夏王。

translations.literal: On jimao, established Prince Bogu as Prince of Xin'an, Bogong as Prince of Jin'an, Boren as Prince of Luling, and Boyi as Prince of Jiangxia.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao he established Prince Bogu as Prince of Xin'an, Bogong as Prince of Jin'an, Boren as Prince of Luling, and Boyi as Prince of Jiangxia.

sentences.zh: 九月，新作大航。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, newly built the Great Bridge.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month the Great Bridge was newly built.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛亥，齊人來聘。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on xinhai, Qi men came seeking audience.
translations.idiomatic: In winter's tenth month, xinhai, Qi envoys came seeking audience.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙卯，立皇子伯禮為武陵王。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on yimao, established Prince Bolin as Prince of Wuling.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, yimao, he established Prince Bolin as Prince of Wuling.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，曲赦都下。

translations.literal: On guihai, partial amnesty for the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai partial amnesty for the capital.

sentences.zh: 天康元年春二月丙子，大赦，改元。

translations.literal: In spring of the first year of Tiankang, second month, on bingzi, great amnesty, changed the era name.
translations.idiomatic: In Tiankang 1, spring, second month, bingzi, he proclaimed great amnesty and changed the era name.

sentences.zh: 三月己卯，以司空安成王頊為尚書令。

translations.literal: In the third month, on jimao, made Minister of Works Prince of Ancheng Xu Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, jimao, Minister of Works Prince of Ancheng Xu became Director of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙卯，皇孫至澤生，賜在位文武帛各有差，為父後者賜爵一級。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on yimao, the imperial grandson Zhize was born; civil and military officials in office were bestowed silk each according to rank; heirs to fathers received noble rank one degree.
translations.idiomatic: In summer's fourth month, yimao, imperial grandson Zhize was born; officials received silk by rank and heirs to fathers one degree of noble rank.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，皇帝崩于有覺殿。

translations.literal: On guiyou, the Emperor died in the Hall of Awakening.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou the Emperor died in the Hall of Awakening.

sentences.zh: 遺詔皇太子可即君臨，山陵務存儉速，大斂竟，群臣三日一臨，公除之制，率依舊典。

translations.literal: The final edict: the Crown Prince may immediately assume rule; the mountain tomb should be kept frugal and swift; when great encoffining is complete, the group of ministers should attend once every three days; the public mourning system—rates follow the old canon.
translations.idiomatic: The final edict: the crown prince may immediately assume rule; the tomb should be kept frugal and swift; when encoffining completes ministers attend once every three days; public mourning rates follow the old canon.

sentences.zh: 六月甲子，群臣上諡曰文皇帝，廟號世祖。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on jiazi, the group of ministers submitted posthumous title Literary Emperor, temple title Shizu.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, jiazi, ministers submitted posthumous title Literary Emperor, temple title Shizu.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，葬永寧陵。

translations.literal: On bingyin, buried at Yongning Tomb.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin he was buried at Yongning Tomb.

sentences.zh: 文帝起自布衣，知百姓疾苦，國家資用，務從儉約。

translations.literal: Emperor Wen rose from common cloth, knew the hundred surnames' toil, and in state revenue and use always followed thrift and economy.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Wen rose from common cloth, knew the people's toil, and in state revenue always followed thrift.

sentences.zh: 妙識真偽，下不容奸。

translations.literal: Keenly discerning true and false, below could not harbor treachery.
translations.idiomatic: Keenly discerning true and false, treachery could not hide below.

sentences.zh: 一夜內刺閨取外事分判者，前後相續。

translations.literal: Within one night he pierced the inner quarters to take outside affairs and divide judgments—before and after in succession.
translations.idiomatic: Within one night he pierced the inner quarters to take outside affairs and divide judgments—again and again.

sentences.zh: 每雞人伺漏傳簽於殿中者，令投簽于階石上，槍然有聲，云：「吾雖得眠，亦令驚覺。

translations.literal: Whenever the cock-man waited for the leak and transmitted the tally in the hall, he ordered the tally thrown on the step stone with a clanging sound, saying: "Though I may sleep, I also make them start awake.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever the night watch transmitted the tally in the hall he ordered it thrown on the step stone with a clanging sound, saying: "Though I sleep, I also make them start awake.

sentences.zh: 」其自強若此云。

translations.literal: " Such was his self-compulsion.
translations.idiomatic: " Such was his self-compulsion.

sentences.zh: 廢帝諱伯宗，字奉業，小字藥王，文帝嫡長子也。

translations.literal: The Deposed Emperor, taboo name Bozong, courtesy name Fengye, childhood name Yaowang, was Emperor Wen's legitimate eldest son.
translations.idiomatic: The Deposed Emperor, personal name Bozong, style Fengye, childhood name Yaowang, was Emperor Wen's legitimate eldest son.

sentences.zh: 梁承聖三年五月庚寅生。

translations.literal: Born in the fifth month of the third year of Chengsheng of Liang, on gengyin.
translations.idiomatic: He was born on gengyin in the fifth month of Liang Chengsheng 3.

sentences.zh: 永定二年二月戊辰，拜臨川王世子。

translations.literal: In the second year of Yongding, second month, on wuchen, appointed Heir of the Prince of Linchuan.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongding 2, second month, wuchen, he was appointed Heir of Prince of Linchuan.

sentences.zh: 三年，文帝嗣位，八月庚戌，立為皇太子。

translations.literal: In the third year, Emperor Wen succeeded to the throne; in the eighth month, on gengxu, established as Crown Prince.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, when Emperor Wen succeeded, in the eighth month, gengxu, he was established as crown prince.

sentences.zh: 自梁室亂離，東宮焚燼，太子居於永福省。

translations.literal: From the Liang house's turmoil and separation, the Eastern Palace was burned to ash; the Crown Prince dwelt in Yongfu Palace.
translations.idiomatic: From the Liang house's turmoil the Eastern Palace burned to ash; the crown prince dwelt in Yongfu Palace.

sentences.zh: 天康元年四月癸酉，文帝崩，是日太子即皇帝位於太極前殿，大赦。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the first year of Tiankang, on guiyou, Emperor Wen died; that same day the Crown Prince ascended the imperial throne at the Hall of Supreme Ultimate, great amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: In Tiankang 1, fourth month, guiyou, Emperor Wen died; that same day the crown prince ascended at the Hall of Supreme Ultimate and proclaimed great amnesty.

sentences.zh: 詔內外文武各復其職，遠方悉停奔赴。

translations.literal: An edict that civil and military inside and outside each restore their posts; distant regions all halt urgent travel.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered civil and military inside and outside to restore their posts and distant regions to halt urgent travel.

sentences.zh: 五月己卯，尊皇太后曰太皇太后，皇后曰皇太后。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on jimao, honored the Empress Dowager as Grand Empress Dowager and the Empress as Empress Dowager.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, jimao, he honored the empress dowager as grand empress dowager and the empress as empress dowager.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以司空、揚州刺史、新除尚書令安成王頊為司徒、錄尚書、都督中外諸軍事。

translations.literal: On gengyin, made Minister of Works, Yangzhou Inspector, newly appointed Director of the Masters of Writing Prince of Ancheng Xu Chancellor, Recording the Masters of Writing, Commander-in-Chief of all armies inside and outside.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Minister of Works, Yangzhou inspector, and newly appointed Director Prince of Ancheng Xu became chancellor, recorder of the Masters of Writing, and commander-in-chief of all armies.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，以中軍大將軍、開府儀同三司徐度為司空，以鎮東將軍、東揚州刺史始興王伯茂為征東將軍、開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: On dingyou, made General of the Central Army, Commissioner with Grand Prefect insignia Xu Du Minister of Works, and General Who Guards the East, Inspector of Dongyang Prince of Shixing Bozong General Who Conquers the East and Commissioner with Grand Prefect insignia.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou General of the Central Army Xu Du with grand prefect insignia became Minister of Works, and General Who Guards the East and Dongyang inspector Prince of Shixing Bozong became General Who Conquers the East with grand prefect insignia.

sentences.zh: 以吏部尚書袁樞為尚書左僕射。

translations.literal: Made Director of the Ministry of Personnel Yuan Shu Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: He made Director of the Ministry of Personnel Yuan Shu Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 以吳興太守沈欽為右僕射。

translations.literal: Made Wuxing Administrator Shen Qin Right Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: He made Wuxing administrator Shen Qin Right Vice Director.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁酉，立妃王氏為皇后。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on dingyou, established Consort Wang as Empress.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn's seventh month, dingyou, he established Consort Wang as empress.

sentences.zh: 冬十月庚申，享太廟。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on gengshen, offered sacrifice at the Grand Temple.
translations.idiomatic: In winter's tenth month, gengshen, he offered sacrifice at the Grand Temple.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙亥，周人來吊。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on yihai, Zhou men came to offer condolences.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, yihai, Zhou envoys came to offer condolences.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲子，高麗國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on jiazi, Goguryeo sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, jiazi, Goguryeo sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 是歲，周天和元年。

translations.literal: That year was Northern Zhou Tianhe first year.
translations.idiomatic: That year was Northern Zhou Tianhe 1.

sentences.zh: 光大元年春正月癸酉，尚書左僕射袁樞卒。

translations.literal: In spring of the first year of Guangda, first month, on guiyou, Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Yuan Shu died.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangda 1, spring, first month, guiyou, Left Vice Director Yuan Shu died.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，大赦，改元，賜孝悌力田爵一級。

translations.literal: On yihai, great amnesty, changed the era name; bestowed filial piety, fraternal duty, and diligent farming noble rank one degree.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai he proclaimed great amnesty, changed the era name, and bestowed one degree of noble rank on filial farmers.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，祀南郊。

translations.literal: On xinmao, sacrificed at the southern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao he sacrificed at the southern suburb.

sentences.zh: 二月辛亥，南豫州刺史余孝頃謀反，伏誅。

translations.literal: In the second month, on xinhai, Southern Yuzhou Inspector Yu Xiaoxiang plotted rebellion and was executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, xinhai, Southern Yuzhou inspector Yu Xiaoxiang plotted rebellion and was executed.

sentences.zh: 三月甲午，以尚書右僕射沈欽為侍中、尚書僕射。

translations.literal: In the third month, on jiawu, made Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Shen Qin Attendant and Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, jiawu, Right Vice Director Shen Qin became attendant and Director of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 夏五月乙未，湘州刺史華皎不從執政，丙申，以中撫軍大將軍淳于量為征南大將軍，總舟師討之。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of summer, on yiwei, Xiang Province Inspector Hua Jiao would not follow the regency; on bingshen, made General Who Pacifies the Center Chunyu Liang General Who Conquers the South and overall commander of the fleet to punish him.
translations.idiomatic: In summer's fifth month, yiwei, Xiangzhou inspector Hua Jiao defied the regency; on bingshen General Who Pacifies the Center Chunyu Liang became General Who Conquers the South and fleet commander against him.

sentences.zh: 六月壬寅，以中軍大將軍、司空徐度為車騎將軍，總督都下眾軍，自步道襲湘州。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on renyin, made General of the Central Army, Minister of Works Xu Du General of Chariots and Cavalry and overall commander of the capital armies, personally marching by land route to raid Xiang Province.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, renyin, General of the Central Army and Minister of Works Xu Du became General of Chariots and Cavalry and commander of the capital armies, marching by land to raid Xiangzhou.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊申，立皇子至澤為皇太子，賜天下為父後者爵一級，王公以下賚帛各有差。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on wushen, established Prince Zhize as Crown Prince; bestowed noble rank one degree upon all heirs to fathers under heaven; princes, dukes, and below were rewarded with silk each according to rank.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn's seventh month, wushen, he established Prince Zhize as crown prince; heirs to fathers under heaven received one degree of noble rank; princes and below received silk by rank.

sentences.zh: 九月丙辰，百濟國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on bingchen, Baekje sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, bingchen, Baekje sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 是月，周將拓拔定入郢州，與華皎水陸俱進，都督淳于量、吳明徹等大破之，皎單舸奔江陵，禽定送建鄴。

translations.literal: That month, Northern Zhou General Tuoba Ding entered Ying Province, advancing together with Hua Jiao by land and water; Commanders Chunyu Liang, Wu Mingche, and others greatly broke them; Jiao escaped in a single boat to Jiangling; Ding was captured and sent to Jiankang.
translations.idiomatic: That month Northern Zhou general Tuoba Ding entered Yingzhou with Hua Jiao advancing by land and water; commanders Chunyu Liang and Wu Mingche broke them; Jiao fled in a lone boat to Jiangling; Ding was captured and sent to Jiankang.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛巳，曲赦湘、巴二州為皎所詿誤者。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on xinsi, partial amnesty for those in Xiang and Ba provinces misled by Jiao.
translations.idiomatic: In winter's tenth month, xinsi, partial amnesty for those in Xiang and Ba provinces misled by Jiao.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲子，中權將軍、開府儀同三司王沖薨。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on jiazi, General of the Central Guard, Commissioner with Grand Prefect insignia Wang Chong died.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, jiazi, General of the Central Guard Wang Chong with grand prefect insignia died.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚寅，以儀同三司兼從事中郎孔英哲為奉聖亭侯，奉孔子祀。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on gengyin, made Commissioner of State and Concurrent Attendant Gentleman Kong Yingzhe Marquis of Fengsheng Pavilion, to serve Confucius's sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, gengyin, Commissioner and concurrent attendant Kong Yingzhe became Marquis of Fengsheng Pavilion to serve Confucius's sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月己亥，司徒、安成王頊進位太傅，領司徒，加殊禮。

translations.literal: In spring of the second year, first month, on jihai, Chancellor Prince of Ancheng Xu was advanced to Grand Preceptor, continuing as Chancellor, with special honors.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year's spring, first month, jihai, Chancellor Prince of Ancheng Xu was advanced to Grand Preceptor, continuing as chancellor with special honors.

sentences.zh: 以新除征南大將軍淳于量為中軍大將軍，及安南將軍、湘州刺史吳明徹即本號並開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: Made newly appointed General Who Conquers the South Chunyu Liang General of the Central Army, and General Who Pacifies the South, Xiang Province Inspector Wu Mingche received his original title plus Commissioner with Grand Prefect insignia.
translations.idiomatic: Newly appointed General Who Conquers the South Chunyu Liang became General of the Central Army, and General Who Pacifies the South and Xiangzhou inspector Wu Mingche received grand prefect insignia with his original title.

sentences.zh: 庚子，詔討華皎軍人死王事者，並給棺槥，送還本鄉，仍復其家。

translations.literal: On gengzi, an edict that officers and soldiers who died in royal service punishing Hua Jiao—all given coffins and sent back to their native districts, their families also restored.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi an edict granted coffins and return to native districts for officers who died punishing Hua Jiao, their families restored.

sentences.zh: 甲子，司空徐度薨。

translations.literal: On jiazi, Minister of Works Xu Du died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi Minister of Works Xu Du died.

sentences.zh: 夏五月丙辰，太傅安成王頊獻玉璽一。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of summer, on bingchen, Grand Preceptor Prince of Ancheng Xu presented one jade seal.
translations.idiomatic: In summer's fifth month, bingchen, Grand Preceptor Prince of Ancheng Xu presented one jade seal.

sentences.zh: 六月丁亥，彗星見。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on dinghai, a comet appeared.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, dinghai, a comet appeared.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊申，新羅國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on wushen, Silla sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn's seventh month, wushen, Silla sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，立皇弟伯智為永陽王，伯謀為桂陽王。

translations.literal: On renxu, established the Emperor's younger brother Bozhi as Prince of Yongyang and Bozou as Prince of Guiyang.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu he established his younger brother Bozhi as Prince of Yongyang and Bozou as Prince of Guiyang.

sentences.zh: 九月，林邑、狼牙修國並遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, Linyi and Langyaxiu both sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Linyi and Langyaxiu both sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月甲寅，慈訓太后令曰：「伯宗昔在儲宮，本無令問、及居崇極，遂騁凶淫。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of winter, on jiayin, the Cixun Empress Dowager's order said: "Bozong formerly in the Eastern Palace had no fair reputation; when he reached the lofty pinnacle he then unleashed fierce debauchery.
translations.idiomatic: In winter's eleventh month, jiayin, the Cixun empress dowager's order said: "Bozong formerly in the Eastern Palace had no fair reputation; when he reached the throne he unleashed fierce debauchery.

sentences.zh: 太傅親承顧托，義深垣屏，而攢塗未禦，翌日無淹，仍遣劉師知、殷不佞等顯言排斥，陰謀禍亂，賴元相維持，但除君側。

translations.literal: The Grand Preceptor personally received the entrustment, righteousness deep as the screen wall, yet the gathered road was not cleared, not one day's delay; still he dispatched Liu Shizhi, Yin Bujiu, and others to speak openly of expulsion, secretly plotting calamity and chaos—relying on the chief minister's maintenance, only removing those beside the ruler.
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Preceptor personally received the entrustment, righteousness deep as a screen wall, yet the road was not cleared for even a day; still he dispatched Liu Shizhi, Yin Bujiu, and others to speak openly of expulsion and secretly plot chaos—relying on the chief minister's maintenance, only removing those beside the ruler.

sentences.zh: 又以餘孝頃密邇京師，便相徵召，宗社之靈，祅氛是滅。

translations.literal: Also because Yu Xiaoxiang was close to the capital, he was then summoned; the altars' spirits, demon vapor was thereby extinguished.
translations.idiomatic: Also because Yu Xiaoxiang lay close to the capital he was summoned; the altars' spirits extinguished the demon vapor.

sentences.zh: 於是密詔華皎，稱兵上流，國祚憂惶，幾移丑類。

translations.literal: Then secretly edicting Hua Jiao, he raised troops upstream; the state's fortune was anxious and fearful, almost shifting to ugly kinds.
translations.idiomatic: Then secretly edicting Hua Jiao he raised troops upstream; the state's fortune trembled, almost shifting to villains.

sentences.zh: 又別敕歐陽紇等攻逼衡州，嶺表紛紜，殊淹弦望。

translations.literal: Also separately ordering Ouyang He and others to press Heng Province; south of the ranges turmoil spread, greatly delaying the bowstring's hope.
translations.idiomatic: Also separately ordering Ouyang He and others to press Hengzhou; south of the ranges turmoil spread, greatly delaying hope.

sentences.zh: 但賊豎皆亡，日望懲改，而悖禮忘德，情性不悛。

translations.literal: Yet the villainous leaders all perished; day by day one hoped for reform and change—yet he violated rites and forgot virtue, nature and disposition unrepentant.
translations.idiomatic: Yet the villainous leaders all perished and day by day one hoped for reform—yet he violated rites and forgot virtue, nature unrepentant.

sentences.zh: 蕩主侯法喜等，太傅麾下，恒遊府內，啖以深利，謀興肘腋；

translations.literal: Chief of the Tent Hou Faxi and others, under the Grand Preceptor's command, constantly roamed within the offices; fed with deep profit, they plotted armpit-level rising;
translations.idiomatic: Tent chief Hou Faxi and others under the Grand Preceptor's command constantly roamed the offices; fed with deep profit they plotted rising at the armpit;

sentences.zh: 又蕩主孫泰等潛相連結，大有交通，天誘其衷，自然開發。

translations.literal: also Chief of the Tent Sun Tai and others secretly linked together, greatly communicating—Heaven tempted their hearts and naturally exposed them.
translations.idiomatic: also tent chief Sun Tai and others secretly linked together in great communication—Heaven tempted their hearts and naturally exposed them.

sentences.zh: 此諸文跡，今以相示，豈可復肅恭禋祀，臨御生靈。

translations.literal: These various documents and traces are now shown you—how can one again reverently perform sacrificial rites and face and govern the living masses?
translations.idiomatic: These documents and traces are now shown you—how can one again reverently perform sacrifice and govern the living masses?

sentences.zh: 今可特降為臨海郡王，送還藩邸。

translations.literal: Now he may specially be demoted to Prince of Linhai and sent back to his princely residence.
translations.idiomatic: Now he may specially be demoted to Prince of Linhai and sent back to his princely residence.

sentences.zh: 太傅安成王，固天生德，齊聖廣深，二後鍾心，三靈佇眷。

translations.literal: Grand Preceptor Prince of Ancheng Xu—固 by nature born with virtue, equal sage and broadly deep; the two empresses fixed their hearts, the three spirits awaited their favor.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Preceptor Prince of Ancheng Xu—by nature born with virtue, equal sage and broadly deep; the two empresses fixed their hearts, the three spirits awaited their favor.

sentences.zh: 自前朝不豫，任總邦家，威惠相宣，刑禮兼設。

translations.literal: From the former court's illness, he bore overall task for state and house; prestige and kindness mutually proclaimed, punishment and rites jointly established.
translations.idiomatic: From the former court's illness he bore overall task for state and house; prestige and kindness mutually proclaimed, punishment and rites jointly established.

sentences.zh: 且地彰靈璽，天表長彗，布新除舊，禎祥咸顯。

translations.literal: Moreover the earth displayed the spirit seal, Heaven showed the long comet; spreading the new and removing the old, auspicious omens all displayed.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover the earth displayed the spirit seal and Heaven showed the long comet; spreading the new and removing the old, auspicious omens all displayed.

sentences.zh: 文皇知子之鑒，事甚帝堯，傳弟之懷，久符太伯。

translations.literal: Emperor Wen's knowledge of sons' mirror—matter very like Emperor Yao; the heart of transmitting to a younger brother—long matched Grand Earl.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Wen's mirror for knowing sons very like Emperor Yao; the heart of transmitting to a younger brother long matched Grand Earl.

sentences.zh: 今可還申舊志，崇立賢君，外宜依舊典，奉迎輿駕。

translations.literal: Now he may again declare the former will, honor and establish the worthy ruler; outwardly should follow the old canon, welcome and escort the imperial carriage.
translations.idiomatic: Now he may again declare the former will, honor and establish the worthy ruler; outwardly follow the old canon and welcome the imperial carriage.

sentences.zh: 」是日，帝出居別第。

translations.literal: " That same day, the Emperor moved out to dwell in a separate residence.
translations.idiomatic: " That same day the emperor moved out to a separate residence.

sentences.zh: 太建二年四月乙卯薨，時年十九。

translations.literal: In the second year of Taijian, fourth month, on yimao, he died, age nineteen.
translations.idiomatic: In Taijian 2, fourth month, yimao, he died at age nineteen.

sentences.zh: 帝性仁弱，無人君之器，及即尊位，政刑皆歸塚宰，故宣太后稱文帝遺志而廢焉。

translations.literal: The Emperor's nature was benevolent and weak, without the vessel of a ruler; when he reached the honored position, government and punishment all returned to the regent; hence the Empress Dowager Xuan, citing Emperor Wen's final will, deposed him.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor's nature was benevolent and weak, without a ruler's vessel; when he reached the honored position government and punishment all returned to the regent; hence Empress Dowager Xuan, citing Emperor Wen's final will, deposed him.

sentences.zh: 論曰：陳武帝以雄毅之姿，屬殷憂之運，功存拯溺，道濟橫流，應變無方，蓋惟人傑。

translations.literal: The commentary says: Chen Emperor Wu with fierce and resolute bearing met the era of deep sorrow; merit preserved rescuing the drowning, the Way crossed the drowning torrent; responding to change without fixed method—truly a hero among men.
translations.idiomatic: The commentary says: Emperor Wu of Chen with fierce resolute bearing met an era of deep sorrow; merit preserved the drowning and the Way crossed the torrent; responding to change without fixed method—truly a hero among men.

sentences.zh: 及乎西都蕩覆，江表阽危，僧辯任同伊尹，空結桐宮之恨，貞陽入假秦兵，不息穆嬴之泣。

translations.literal: When the western capital was overthrown and the lands east of the river stood on the brink, Sengbian's task equaled Yi Yin's—yet only the Tung Palace's resentment was bound; Zhenyang entered borrowing Qin troops—the Mu Ying tears did not cease.
translations.idiomatic: When the western capital fell and the lands east of the river stood on the brink, Sengbian's task equaled Yi Yin's—yet only Tung Palace resentment was bound; Zhenyang entered borrowing Qin troops—and Mu Ying's tears did not cease.

sentences.zh: 帝乘隙以舉，乃蹈玄機，王業所基，始自于此，柴天改物，蓋有憑云。

translations.literal: The Emperor seized the gap and rose, then tread the dark mechanism; the royal enterprise's foundation began from here; burning firewood and changing things—surely had cloud to rely upon.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor seized the gap and rose, then tread the hidden mechanism; the royal enterprise's foundation began here; burning firewood and changing the mandate—surely had cloud to rely upon.

sentences.zh: 文帝以宗枝承統，情存兢惕，加以崇尚儒術，愛悅文義，恭儉行己，勤勞濟物，志度弘遠，有前哲之風，至於臨下明察，得永平之政矣。

translations.literal: Emperor Wen with clan branch received the succession, in heart preserving caution and fear; moreover honoring Confucian arts, loving and delighting in literary righteousness; respectful thrift in conduct, laboring to aid the masses—ambition and measure broad and far, having former sages' wind; reaching to facing those below with bright discernment, he obtained Yongping-era government.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Wen with clan branch received succession, heart preserving caution; moreover honoring Confucian arts and delighting in literary righteousness; respectful thrift in conduct, laboring to aid the masses—ambition broad and far with former sages' wind; facing those below with bright discernment he obtained Yongping-era government.

sentences.zh: 臨海懦弱，有同於帝摯，文後雖欲不鑒殷道，蓋亦其可得邪。

translations.literal: Linhai was weak and soft, the same as Emperor Zhi; though Empress Wen afterward wished not to mirror Yin's Way—could she obtain it?
translations.idiomatic: Linhai was weak and soft, the same as Emperor Zhi; though Empress Wen afterward wished not to mirror the Yin Way—could she obtain it?
